notes.title: Awesomenauts Premium Relaunch - Update For June 17th, 2025
notes.notes:
[p]We have exciting news: we are taking a big step towards reintroducing content and improving the playing experience in Awesomenauts.[/p][p][/p][p]Awesomenauts will be returning to its roots as a premium title. We have pushed the new, premium version to the [b][i]Beta Branch [/i][/b](premium-beta) for community testing and introduced a purchase price of $19.99 for new players on Steam. The testing period is expected to last about a month, after which the premium build will be pushed to the Main Branch.[/p][p][/p][p]We have been able to add all of the content and character skins that were pulled offline back into the game, including the paid Starstorm and Overdrive expansions which are now included in the base game for all players. We are also working on a back-office moderation tool that will allow us to police negative behavior that users report. That tool will be released with the update later this month. Until then, we have disabled in-game chat.[/p][p][/p][p]We encourage you to play the version we have just loaded into the Beta Branch and give us feedback in the [url="https://discord.gg/WStkV3u6TG"]Discord channel[/url].[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Awesomenauts Community Update – Patch Notes For January 17th
notes.notes:
Let’s talk about Awesomenauts,

We want to take a moment to address the current state of the game and share some exciting news about our efforts to bring Awesomenauts back to the players. While we haven’t shared much publicly until now, we’ve been working hard behind the scenes ever since Atari acquired the game last October. Our mission at Atari is to preserve and celebrate the games players love, and Awesomenauts is no exception.

When we took over from Ronimo, the game was not in a sustainable state—both operationally and economically. Quite simply the game costs far more to support than it made in revenue because of the way it was engineered and hosted. We've dedicated some time and money into re-engineering the backend services so that the game can be operated cost effectively. We're excited to say that we believe we’re close to a solution.

Although there’s more work to be done, we want to share our current roadmap with you:

[h1]Today: Back to Awesomenauts 3.2.8[/h1]

Starting today, we are moving version 3.2.8 of the game to the main branch on Steam. For those of you familiar with the beta code version, this is now publicly available to everyone without needing steam access codes. While this version is missing the past four years of live ops content, it is the most stable and playable version available to us. Please keep in mind that this is a temporary solution. 

Characters that are no longer available:

[list]
[*] Snork Gunk
[*] Qi'Tara
[*] Commander Rocket
[*] Smiles
[*] Dizzy
[*] Samuel 'Deadlift' Gains
[*] Max Focus
[/list]
Features/functionality that are no longer available:

[list]
[*] Matchmaking improvements since 3.2.8
[*] Rejoin or get locked out of matchmaking after alt-F4 or crash
[*] Custom games browser
[*] Online Replays and live spectating
[*] Parties which persist across matches
[*] Weekly Brawls matchmaking queue
[*] Co-op vs. bots matchmaking queue
[*] Global Chat
[*] Dailies
[*] Online currencies and unlocks (unlockables include characters, drop pods and icons)
[*] Some modding features
[*] Balance adjustments since 3.2.8
[*] Simplified Chinese translation
[/list]
[h1]Looking Ahead: Galactron Version Testing[/h1]

Following the 3.2.8 release, we’ll be launching a Galactron Test Branch. This branch will gradually implement content from the "Galactron" version of the game (the state it was in when the servers were shut down.) We’ll need your help testing this version to ensure it’s stable and playable.

As we work to restore characters and features we will be making updates to the game’s code which may introduce bugs or break some functionality.  We’re relying on the community to be patient with us through this process and encourage you to provide feedback and issue reports. Your input will be crucial in ensuring Awesomenauts returns to its best possible state.

Our goal is to reestablish as much of the original experience as possible.

[h1]Access to DLC Content[/h1]

Once the Galactron version is restored, any DLC that was previously purchased will be available. For example, if you purchased a skin in the past, you will have access to use it again. 

[h1]Thank You for Your Patience[/h1]

We understand that this has been a long road, and we truly appreciate your patience and dedication to Awesomenauts. We’re committed to restoring much of the game to its former glory, and we can’t wait to celebrate its return with all of you.

Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll be counting on your feedback in the months to come!

Thanks for sticking with us,

– The Atari Team

notes.title: Issues in Nauts since 19th Sept 2022
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we have some unfortunate news. Since Monday 19th September, a host of issues popped up in Nauts and we have very little idea as to what caused them. We have contacted Steam and are also looking into this ourselves. But considering that this seemed to have happened out of the blue, we do not yet know how to approach solving the issues, so do not have an estimate when these issues will be fixed. We will keep you updated if we have any new information. 

Problems experienced:
[list]
[*] Free Nauts rotations differ for different players.
[*] Nauts do not unlock using in-game currency. Error message “Purchase failed: Could not grant Steam DLC!”.
[*] Redeemed Nauts, skins, and other items do not show up in-game for players. 
[*] Purchased Nauts, skins, and other items do not show up in-game for players. 
[*] Prices of Nauts, skins, bundles, and other items show up as “$0,00”, even though they are correctly priced in the Steam store. 
[*] Players are only able to choose the default skin option for each Naut. [/list]
If you have recently purchased Nauts DLC and wish to get a refund, please contact [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/ ]Steam Support[/url] and create a ticket for the item(s) in question. 
One comparatively fortunate factor is that matchmaking is not affected, so players can still play the game with Nauts that have already been unlocked, or are currently on the free rotation. 
We apologise for this inconvenience and will keep you updated once we find out more.

notes.title: 🎂 Awesomenauts 10-Year Anniversary Celebrations + Present 🎁
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/69e5513cdd66a049abc45172509b538e2a0711fb.png[/img]

Awesomenauts turns 10-years old on 1st August 2022! We would like to thank everyone who has been a part of this incredible journey with us! 


[h3]Anniversary Stream[/h3]
On Thursday 4th August, we will be celebrating with our community on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ronimogames]our Twitch channel[/url] at 7pm CET, 1pm ET, 10am PT. 

6 devs will be playing in an internal tournament live on stream where we will once-and-for-all crown who is the best dev at Awesomenauts! We will play 3 games of Nauts with an individualised scoring system where teams are reshuffled after every game. The winners of each game receive 3 points each, while each player who receives a crown will get an extra point, regardless of being on the winning or losing team. After each game, teams are shuffled so the point totals per team are as equal as possible. Winners of game 3 will get 4 points for the win, and each crown earned in game 3 is worth 1.5 points. 
As part of the stream, we will also be assembling a 3D printed Clunk figurine (see below) as well as painting one. A 3D-printable Clunk figurine is our present to this awesome community, for more details, see the “Anniversary Present” section below. 

We will also be raffling out 3 original Clunk figurines during the stream. As usual, shipping is on us! 


[h3]Anniversary Tournament[/h3]
The Nutty Nauts tournament series has returned for a 5th iteration! Matches will be of a standard 3v3 format and will take place on the weekends of 13th August and 20th August. 

For more details, check out this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/3404176020709330893 ]Steam post[/url], or join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/QkRFBP8W9M ]Nutty Nauts Discord[/url]. 


[h3]Anniversary Present[/h3]
We know the Clunk figurine is a very sought-after collectible and it has not been available since the initial pre-order many years ago. For the 10-year anniversary of Awesomenauts, we decided to make the Clunk figurine 3D printable and accessible to everyone who has a 3D printer, has access to a 3D printer, or wants to use a 3D printing service to acquire a Clunk figurine. You can find all the relevant files, instructions, and recommendations in the #announcement channel in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ronimo ]Ronimo Games Community Discord[/url].

To add a little caveat, there are a few of us at the studio who are 3D printing hobbyists, but by no means do we consider these to be professional quality. To make the Clunk figurine 3D-printable, we separated the figurine into 10 individual parts, slightly tweaked them to optimise them for 3D printing, and also added pegs for easier assembly. We also test printed and assembled the Clunk figurine using a resin (Photon S) 3D printer and a filament (Ultimaker 2 Extended) 3D printer. We will also be assembling and painting 3D printed Clunk figurines on the 10-year anniversary stream on 4th August.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/1c43e022715d53cd1c459fafdd108994bb663073.png[/img]

In the picture above, the original Clunk figurine is the one that was available for pre-order years ago. The one on the right was printed using a Photon S resin 3D printer with the same part sizes as in the raw files. The one on the left was printed using a Ultimaker 2 Extended filament 3D printer.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ronimo ]In our Discord[/url], we have provided the raw files of all the parts, a template for resin 3D printers, as well as recommendations and instructions for filament 3D printers.

For resin printers, we have also created a 120mm by 68mm (4.7” by 2.6”) template including print supports tips of 0.5mm (0.019”) thickness. This template allows all the parts to be printed at once for resin printers. This template can also be scaled larger, if the printer you are using allows it. This is the template that was used for the Clunk figurine in the picture above. This file can be opened and modified with [url=https://www.chitubox.com/en/download/chitubox-free ]Chitubox Basic[/url], which is the free software we used to create this template. Other softwares are of course available. The Clunk figurine printed with the resin 3D printer is printed at the unaltered size of each part in the raw files. Assembling this Clunk was relatively easy. Once the parts dried and the supports removed, it took no longer than 45 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/0781bd6a780458d4093113fbc99d590e1431cbbd.png[/img]

For filament printers, we included print orientation recommendations and print instructions for each individual part. The Clunk figurine printed with the filament 3D printer is printed at 150% of the size of each part in the raw 3D files. Theoretically, the raw files can be scalable to be either larger or smaller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/2baaab0aab1ceb6934ebe83e3c85946c8befd34a.png[/img]

We found the assembling process more finicky with the Clunk printed with the filament printer. The pegs that connect the different parts together are designed to fit “perfectly”, but there will always be a margin of error in the printing process. So once all the parts are printed, there is a chance that they will not connect perfectly with each other, so we recommend to do some level of sanding and drilling, as well as applying glue to each connection point for extra structural integrity. We will be going through this process [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ronimogames]on stream[/url] on 4th August so there is a good reference point for people who would like to undergo the process of 3D printing and assembling a Clunk figurine of their own.

Please keep in mind that removing supports, assembling figurines, and generally handling 3D printed objects and potentially sharp plastics can be dangerous and cause injury if not done properly and carefully. Ronimo Games is not responsible for any injuries or loss of life that may occur.

If you decide to print off your own Clunk figurine, be sure to share it with us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/ronimo ]Discord[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/204300 ]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Awesomenauts ]reddit[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/RonimoGames ]Twitter[/url], and/or [url=https://www.instagram.com/ronimogamesofficial/ ]Instagram[/url]! We are very excited to see all the different Clunk figurines!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 10th Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/69e5513cdd66a049abc45172509b538e2a0711fb.png[/img]

Awesomenauts will be turning 10 years old in August! We would like to thank everyone who has been part of this incredible journey! 🥳

Leading up to the 10th anniversary of Nauts, we will be taking a stroll down memory lane. [b]Every week leading up to 1st August[/b], we will be taking a look at a tournament match of Awesomenauts from each of the 10 years the game has been out, starting from this [b]Wednesday 18th May[/b], we will be live on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ronimogames]Official Ronimo Twitch Channel[/url] at 10am PT 1pm ET 7pm CET where I will be joined by Lead Animator Koen, who has been working at Ronimo since early 2012. We will review and break down a tournament match that took place in March 2013. 

🎉 [h3]Celebration Plans[/h3] 
Every week, we will be watching, reviewing, and breaking down a different match of Nauts from a different year. You may see guest appearances of some new faces, some old faces, and also some community favourites too! We will be talking about how Nauts has changed over the years, reminiscing the highs and lows, our favourite updates, metas, Nauts, maps, as well as our least favourite, of course. You can also expect some development insights and interesting stories we have had since we started Awesomenauts development in late 2008. 

🎁 [h3]Rewards [/h3] 
Although we stopped development for Awesomenauts since 2018 and have no plans to revisit the IP in the foreseeable future, we still plan on giving a "present" back to this amazing community to mark such a momentous occasion for the game. But we are not quite ready to reveal more details on this mystery gift yet. 

Since we will be doing weekly reviews on our Twitch channel, you can also redeem rewards with Roni Points by just tuning in to the streams. Check out the latest rewards rotation [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/3207137199331111743]here[/url].

notes.title: Survivornauts Tournament Sign-Ups LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/4ec6d7c6389a9530301a6dc020c4d6dcc4eeac79.png[/img]

The Survivornauts Tournament is nearing and [b]sign-ups will end in 1 week on Sunday 29th August[/b]! We’re mixing it up this tournament and will be introducing a more casual-friendly ruleset where meta Nauts might be banned if they are picked too often 🤔

Here’s a simple rundown of the rules:
- The tournament will take place over 4 weekends. Weekends 1, 2, and 3 will be group stages. Weekend 4 will be playoffs. 
- In week 1, all Nauts are available for selection for competition. 
- After each week, 8 of the most played Nauts will go through a raffle system and 4 will be banned for the rest of the tournament. So there will be 12 Nauts banned over 3 weeks, and a final 22 Nauts available for selection for the playoffs in week 4.

[b]To find out more about the tournament and to sign up, join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PGCUy3mkf5]Tournament Discord[/url].[/b]

If you don’t have a team yet but would like to participate, jump in the Discord and post a message in the #looking-for-team channel.

The winners will be rewarded with in-game medals, but [b]EVERY [/b]participant will receive a skin or announcer reward (the better you do, the better the reward)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/e7335f19c7ed80dc8ebd292bdd492e35bb9ddbc2.png[/img]

notes.title: Help Us Decide The Next Tournament!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/4ec6d7c6389a9530301a6dc020c4d6dcc4eeac79.png[/img]

The next Awesomenauts tournament is coming up at the end of this month! We would like you to help us decide the tournament format! We have 2 proposals, Randomnauts and Survivornauts. Here are brief summaries of the rulesets of each format.

[b]Randomnauts[/b]
- The Nauts played by each team is selected at random. 
- The original gamemode “Randomnauts” will be used with “medium ai” bots selected (the middle option).

[b]Survivornauts[/b]
- The tournament will take place over 4 weekends. Weekends 1,2, and 3 will be group stages. Weekend 4 will be playoffs. 
- In week 1, all Nauts are available for selection for competition. 
- After each week, 8 of the most played Nauts will go through a raffle system and 4 will be banned for the rest of the tournament. So there will be 12 Nauts banned over 3 weeks, and a final 22 Nauts available for selection for the playoffs in week 4. 

[b]All Nauts will be on free rotation for ALL PLAYERS during the duration of the tournament![/b]

For more details, join the [url=https://discord.gg/PGCUy3mkf5]Naut Even Trying Discord[/url].

notes.title: Introducing... the Ronimo Collection
notes.notes:
You lucky ducks! We've given you something pretty awesome.

What's that? Well, we'd like to introduce you to the Ronimo Collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3948077/7d60da8ba2ee5c0316a135928908df460ade1dc8.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263070/Blightbound/

In celebration of our upcoming game Blightbound, we've put together a bundle covering our complete history - from the Viking lands of Swords & Soldiers HD to the Persian deserts of Swords & Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon and Awesomenauts' Startstorm Station!

If you want to play everything we've ever made, or maybe just complete your collection, you've come to the right place! And... you have impeccable taste!

This bundle contains:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/

The Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack is back, temporarily! This bundle will give you access to all existing characters in Awesomenauts, as well as unlock the exclusive Golden Lonestar skin! If you're looking for the full Awesomenauts experience - this is it!

Never played Awesomenauts? Don't fret! This pack will set you up with absolutely everything you need. It's a side-scrolling MOBA that pits you and two allies up against three opponents, wielding characters like a jetpacking monkey, a robot with anger-management issues, and a sawblade-throwing techno-shaman, and lots lots more. Interested? The game is free to play, so go and give it a spin!

Once this promotion ends, the Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack will be retired once again.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/703880/Swords_and_Soldiers_2_Shawarmageddon/

Swords & Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon is the sequel that sees our beloved Chief Redbeard travel the globe in search of a mysterious artifact, only to uncover a sinister plot to take over the world! Still, it's a lighthearted strategy affair that throws different challenges and puzzles your way.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/63500/Swords_and_Soldiers_HD/

The game that started it all for us! Swords and Soldiers HD is a sidescrolling strategy game where you take control of the Viking, Chinese, and Aztec armies while they exchange food-based puns and fight over a mind-controlling chili.

notes.title: Ronimo & Devolver Digital Unveil Blightbound!!
notes.notes:
In partnership with Devolver Digital, Ronimo Games has been hard at work developing Blightbound, a new co-op action RPG set in a blight cursed land filled with monsters and gribblies. 

Players will take the role of adventurers living in the Refuge, one of the few (if maybe the last!) vestige of good and light in the land. From their plateau, they strike out at the evil that has consumed the world around them, earning not just experience, loot, and glory, but finding survivors and fellow playable heroes; many of these heroes also have a great deal of history with each other and the places they inhabit. 

It's easily Ronimo's most ambitious project so far!

If you want to keep up to date with Blightbound while it is in development, then we highly suggest taking a look at the store page, adding the game to your wish-list, and following the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263070/Blightbound/

For one, we're excited to announce that Blightbound will be available for Early Access around mid-summer!

Blightedly yours,
-SlowWolf.

Awesomenauts Conquest will feature a series of one-off tournaments with a BRAND NEW drafting method unlike any other implemented in previous tournaments.

You and your team must create powerful combinations and prove your might by winning with a variety of different strategies!

Basic overview:
Teams must submit 3 team compositions before each bracket. These 3 compositions will then be used for the remainder of the bracket. 
Instead of a standard drafting phase, each team will ban one team composition drawn up by their oppositions. Teams must win with both of the remaining compositions to proceed to the next stage of the competition. 

Good luck to all competitors! Time to dominate!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 7 Year Anniversary Celebrations
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2f2f8fca4f1f88e4f81868eca4607bd230f80f55.png[/img]Awesomenauts will soon be celebrating its 7th birthday! To spice up the party, we will be having the biggest and longest sale we’ve EVER had! Starting from Monday April 22nd, selected characters, skins and announcers will be 60% off, these corresponding characters will also be unlocked and playable for everyone (on top of the random weekly rotation)! Sales and characters are renewed every Monday and this cycle will go on for at least the next 2 months (and most likely longer)! More details of Nauts’ birthday celebrations will follow in due course 👍

This is a great time to introduce a friend who you think might like Nauts, they'll get to play the complete roster over the coming weeks and also score some sweet deals! 👌

notes.title: Leaderboards Have Been Reset!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d8f0a92ae89e38dfcfb2c6b8c8a9afb5962162de.jpg[/img]A new season has commenced in Awesomenauts on Steam! If you are reading this, the leaderboards have been reset. Could this be the season you finally get your crack at League 1? Expect being matched with players of mixed skill levels in the first few days.

If you have played fewer than 100 games, you will automatically get a reduced rating so you’re not playing against a high-ranked player. Everyone else will be reset to a rating of 10,000.

This reset only influences your leaderboard rating. You’ll keep any character and account progress you’ve made.

We’re also planning to reset leaderboards more regularly from this point onward, so stay on your toes! 

Good luck in the new season!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Art Contest!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/73e0ce6f5e2f8acaf15c7e3e670aac42a9f54940.png[/img]Hey everyone, we hope you all had a good start to the new year! We would like to announce that Rexic is hosting another art contest! The theme for this contest is Valentine’s Day celebrations and you can submit any Naut you want, but of course, Coco submissions are encouraged because the radical purple surfer is Rexic’s favourite. The setting is of your choosing, your Naut(s) could be giving/receiving presents, going on a date or just being generally in love 😊 Entries must be submitted before midnight on Valentines Day, so 23:59 on February 14th (Pacific Time). If you happen to be one of the winners, you will receive:
-	$75 for first place
-	$50 for second place
-	$25 for third place

But wait, there’s more! Everyone who enters by submitting a piece of art will also receive a free game code from Rexic’s list of game codes. 

All submissions should be labelled ‘Rexic Valentine’s Day Art Contest’ and be posted on this forum thread https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=12&t=53672 . Feel free to share your works of art on other platforms as well but be sure to submit it in the forum thread for it to be entered into the contest. We look forward to all the amazing art that will be submitted!

In the meantime, check out Luckytime’s creation which took first place in the Halloween Art Contest!

notes.title: Swords And Soldiers 2: Shawarmageddon brings the beef back to PC today
notes.notes:
Silly side-scrolling RTS Swords And Soldiers 2: Shawarmageddon might be a few years overdue (it launched on Wii U back in May 2015), but it still knows how to raise a smile. Its meat-hungry armies of Vikings and Demons also make me wish that I had a decent barbecue setup to hand, but that’s neither here nor there. It’s out today on PC after a long absence, and developed by Ronimo Games, better known on PC now for the still-popular platform MOBA Awesomenauts. Below, a meaty launch trailer.

notes.title: Update 4.7: Slam Dunk is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/49d172c748bf7f94396437054ce0eaefbf597dec.png[/img]Update 4.7 and Snork Gunk are now live! Here is the back story to our conchballing, butt-whooping hero:

Although Snork Gunk is considered one of the better conchballers in Scargi space he never reached first league with his team the Pearl Sluggers. He always criticized that the sport had become too slow and blamed the slugs at management for trying to slow the pace of the game (which was already drawn out over the span of 14 Earth months).

“With an average of only one or two goals a game, you have more fun watching paint dry,” he complained. After many times of being disqualified for scoring too quickly, the team benched him for good.

Fed up with his failed career in sports he decided to join the Scargi military police hoping for some more action by tracking and hunting down enemies of the Empire. After a good run of swift catches, he was assigned on a mission to hunt down the fugitive Rocket Renegades. Realising the Renegades had joined the ranks of the Awesomenauts, a team of 'big league' mercenaries, he applied for the transfer of a lifetime...

For the complete patch notes, click here: https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=2440 

We hope you enjoy Snork and Update 4.7 as much as we do and hope to see you in-game soon!

notes.title: Awesomenauts and the GDPR
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823e6273ceccc808072f281caee869a568e6e153.png[/img]Hey everyone, as you have probably heard in recent news, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) will go into full effect this week. As we process and store some data relating to your Awesomenauts account, we’d like to take a moment to let you know what this means for you and Awesomenauts.

In order to provide you with some of the essential components of the Awesomenauts service, we have to store data relating to your account. This allows us to provide you with matchmaking services, a player profile, progression, in-game unlocks, customer and technical support, and much more. The bottom line is that we don’t store or use any data except as needed to provide you with the full Awesomenauts experience, so we won’t use any of the data we store for these purposes for marketing or anything else.

We have updated the EULA that pops up the first time you launch Awesomenauts to provide a little more information on the data we collect and what we use this data for. As the document has updated you’ll be asked to accept it again, but all the changes are just to further clarify what was already there.

The processing, storage, and use of personal data is a hot topic and we take it very seriously. If you have any questions or concerns about it, please let us know in the comments below or get in touch on robin@ronimo-games.com.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d9fd955a7a5293eaf0a400777230c05ff0e821a8.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time has launched on Steam, including a wide array of balance tweaks and gameplay improvements! A big thanks to everyone who participated in the open beta for this update and shared their thoughts on some of the planned changes.

Please share your thoughts on the update below or on [url=https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=6]our official forums[/url]. We're already working on a hotfix to address some unintended changes and bugs that crept into the release, so please stay tuned on that! This hotfix is slated to release on Friday 20th April, and we'll have patch notes on that when we get closer to its release.

The full patch notes for Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time are included below.

[H1]Update 4.6: Tinker Time[/H1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cf19c3b5917941055204147d2b4745161cdff74c.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b]
[i]Currently too safe and very hard to catch, Rocket needs to be easier to punish[/i][list]
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Base Health, reduced from 1150 to 1100[/list]
[i]Laser Trap is too unreliable, doing either too much damage or none at all. These changes should make its effect more reliable while also making placement a little bit more skillful.[/i][list]
[*]Laser Trap, time between damage ticks increased from 0.2 to 0.3.
[*]Laser Trap, damage per tick increased from 60 to 90.
[*]Laser Trap, rotation speed increased by 50%.
[*]Laser Trap, laser length reduced by 10%.
[*]Laser Trap, no longer has deployment time.
[*]Laser Trap, duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds. [/list]
[i]Some upgrade adjustments based on the above changes. These are intended to keep Rocket brawling closer to his Laser Trap.[/i][list]
[*]Profanity filters, now increases trap duration by 2 seconds for 160 solar.
[*]Borgo Cigar cutter, CMDR Rocket gets a shield which reduces 30% of the incoming damage as long as he is nearby a deployed laser trap. [/list]
[i]This upgrade is still too strong and mandatory[/i]
[*]Box of Cirean cigars, damage per particle per stage reduced from 20 to 16. [/list]
[i]His Rocket Launch no longer deals damage to turrets, but his turret push is still too intense. Adjusting the numbers and making them more consistent.[/i] [list]
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against droids increased from 75% to 80%
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against turrets reduced from 100% to 80%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade was a holdover from a time where Rocket’s Laser Trap had a lot more uptime. The intention for this replacement is to enable Rocket to be a bit better at brawling and allowing him to stay a bit closer to the fight[/i] [list]
[*]Head in Jar, now adds 16% damage to Charged Salvo when firing a single rocket, two stages for 175 solar each. [/list]
[i]Part of his safety comes from his relatively high ranged base attack.[/i] [list]
[*]Charged Salvo, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Medal Booster Pack, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.[/list]
[i]Combining Rocket Launch and a full Charged Salvo at melee range provides too much damage, too easily. At the same time we want to stimulate him to get more into the thick of the fight.[/i] [list]
[*]Rocket Launch, now deals between 150 and 350 damage, depending on how long the rocket has been flying.
[*]Mother of Bombs, after using Rocket Launch without hitting an enemy, your next Charged Salvo shot will deal 100 more damage for 170 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823d399cc943558129d3bb1f405c248306662d21.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]We consider Derpl a bit too strongly affected by map choice and enemy team choices. Our intention is to weaken him a bit on the maps where he does too well, while also strengthening him against his counters.[/i] [list]
[*]Siege mode, Derpl is no longer immune to CC during the transformation out of siege mode.
[*]Siege mode, Derpl's CC immunity now also works against timeslow effects and cocoons.
[*]Combustion lava lamp, size increase reduced from 22% to 18%.
[*]Falling acceleration reduced by 20%.[/list]
[i]Traps can be very oppressive, maxing out at full 2.4 seconds of no gameplay for the receiving party. Their long lifetime also stimulates camping gameplay.[/i] [list]
[*]Trap, snare duration reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds
[*]Trap, now also slows for 30% for 2.4 seconds. (extenting 1.2 seconds beyond the snare)
[*]Trap, base lifetime reduced from 11 to 9 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, snare increase per stage reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.
[*]Lead casing, the silence now has a fixed duration of 2 seconds.
[*]Trap, now charges in the middle of Derpl instead of having an arming time when placed.
[*]Trap, deployment time reduced from 0.6 to 0.4 seconds. [/list]
[i]Some base attack adjustments to better balance the row and take the above changes into account.[/i] [list]
[*]Fat Cat, cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds, price increased from 185 to 195.
[*]Kitty Catsuit, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]CAT package, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Bat Catsuit, now deals 100% increased damage against Nauts who are snared or slowed, no longer works with Fat Cat.
[*]Long Cat, now works with Fat Cat. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/306d6f4cd9cfb2e4744d49e424863f0562d72426.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Dizzy is currently a bit too strong. But she's also very finicky, and has a lot of weak upgrades.[/i] [list]
[*]Multi Dash, time between dashes increased from 0.3 to 0.4 seconds.
[*]Multi Dash, damage per dash increased from 150 to 160.
[*]Walkbot Pro, speed up dash reload time by 30% when you are near to enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone, cooldown increased from 6 to 7 seconds.
[*]Backstage pass, increase the range of your Multi Dash by 50% when you have the maximum amount of dashes charged.
[*]Matching Glittery Dungarees, now reduces the cooldown for the next Explosive Clone by 3 seconds when it hits an enemy Awesomenaut.
[*]"Purple Prince" lipstick, now also slows enemies when they leave the bubble as well as when they are hit by the explosion.
[*]Bubble shot, size increased by 50%.
[*]Graffiti artist, price increased from 165 to 190.
[*]Tipi teal, merged to one stage of 30% range and speed increase for 140 solar.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/89e6d6a97346b9e10bb82ea3b76823a8a1089bdc.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Ix generally still brings too much to the table overall, great displace move, solid heals, invincibility frames, excellent mobility and strong brawling. In order to nudge him more towards his role his brawling should be reduced.[/i] [list]
[*]Refract, cooldown increased from 9 to 10.
[*]Radiate, damage per Scatter reduced from 15 to 12.
[*]Mammoth hair scarf, ally speed bonus increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Tree hugger, ally damage boost increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Personality Crystal, range increase reduced from 35% to 30%.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/92056c0875f58423dbc8774bae1acad1ef54924d.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b]
[list][*]Ribbit snail slime, fixed that the healthpack would time out if it fell for too long. [/list]
[i]Since these aren’t that much better than regular boots, they also don’t have to cost much more.[/i] [list]
[*]Rocket boots, solar price reduced from 160 to 140.
[*]Base speed, increased by 4%.[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/32af7797f04668c4503d32c67c12e724841d75e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
[i]This item has its use, but it's too weak and expensive.[/i] [list]
[*]From pond to podium, merged into one stage which adds 30% range and speed for 200 solar. [/list]
[i]The homing upgrade looks cool, but doesn't do much. Here is a replacement proposal.[/i] [list]
[*]UFO spotted, now gives +50% speed during Scene Illumination for 160 solar. [/list]
[i]This upgrade is just a bit too expensive, especially given the next change.[/i] [list]
[*]Sadak mysteries, price reduced from 195 to 175 solar. [/list]
[i]Removing the stacking will reduce the need to combo with Sadak.[/i] [list]
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken, damage increased from 120 to 135 per stage, no longer stacks with Sadak mysteries. [/list]
[i]This item is just a bit too expensive.[/i]
[*]Rob Bourgogne, price reduced from 180 to 160 per stage. [/list]
[i]This item was overnerfed shortly after launch, because the skill was too strong to begin with at the time.[/i] [list]
[*]Hairy King, size increase increased from 10% to 15%, price increased from 175 to 200 solar. [/list]
[i]Some overpriced items.[/i] [list]
[*]Don Steward, price per stage reduced from 175 to 140 solar.
[*]Pete Jennirks, price reduced from 240 to 200 solar.
[*]Incriminating dirt, price reduced from 180 to 150 solar.
[*]Flying camera, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar. [/list]
[i]Meanwhile, this one's underpriced.[/i] [list]
[*]Hidden microphone, price increased from 170 to 200 solar. [/list]
[i]This item is the strongest on the row, it doesn't need to stack further.[/i] [list]
[*]Galactic police scanner, no longer stacks with incriminating dirt, price increased from 180 to 220 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed41d63c6b924f52411cec848bbdf99405c2cae4.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b]
[list] [*]Firebreath, fixed that after being Cocooned by Genji during Firebreath she wouldn't resume after the Cocoon wears off. [/list]
[i]Some price adjustments.[/i] [list]
[*]Skull dunduns, price reduced from 200 to 180.
[*]Eye of Coba, price reduced from from 215 to 190.
[*]Dragon Speaker Idol, now has two stages of +10% attack speed each, at 125 solar per stage. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6531b00b86ae6b0bdbc084cc9daad93c01a40cfd.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b]
[i]Some adjustments to improve the item balance for the gaze row.[/i] [list]
[*]Beard Trimming Fork, price reduced from 165 to 130 solar.
[*]Syrup Pouring Robot, maximum lifesteal increased from 120 to 150 per stage. [/list]
[i]Some changes to make Dinos more reliable at base.[/i] [list]
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, now jump at enemies at base.
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, damage per bite reduced from 80 to 75. [/list]
[i]Now this upgrade has become useless.[/i] [list]
[*]Holo Pet Food, now reduces the damage dealt by Nauts who have been bitten by 15% for 1.5 seconds. [/list]

[b]Qi'Tara[/b]
[list][*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that she couldn’t use Chakram Shift to teleport while using Seven Star Strike when the Salty Seal upgrade was bought.
[*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that the Lily of the Isle projectiles would spawn at her feet during Seven Star Strike. [/list]
[i]Qi’Tara deals too much damage during Seven Star Strike, and too little outside of it.[/i] [list]
[*]Seven star strike, attack speed increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Poisonous blade, direct damage increased from 45 to 50. [/list]
[i]Her relationship with speed feels disjointed, where attacking slows her down but Seven Star Strike speed her up etc. These changes also tie in with the issue above.[/i] [list]
[*]Poisonous Blade, removed movement penalty when attacking.
[*]Seven Star Strike, removed speed bonus during the ability. [/list]
[i]With the changes above, this upgrade has now become useless. This change will make Qi’Tara’s damage output more reliable.[/i] [list]
[*]Chilasi Chakram, now speeds up the damage over time of Poisonous blade by 20% for 160 solar. [/list]
[i]Since the bug was fixed where this upgrade doubled your damage, this upgrade has become too weak[/i] [list]
[*]Lily of the Isle, projectile speed and range increased by 30%.[/list]
[i]Salty Seal makes Qi’Tara almost unstoppable, this change should make counterplay possible again[/i] [list]
[*]Salty Seal, now activates a shield that blocks 100 damage and provides immunity against slows, stuns, snares, chains, gravity and time warps as long as it’s active. [/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments.[/i] [list]
[*]Seven star strike, now also gives a 10% lifesteal effect.
[*]Baby plumbin oil, additional lifesteal reduced from 30% to 15% for 175 solar.
[*]Rakki Comb, merged to one stage which adds 200% damage vs. droids for 155 solar. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c3e6b9ea5315191e6b97f4d8f5951b5c8162cf62.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b]
[list] [*]Iron Rifle, fixed that the shield didn’t last long enough to protect the entire charge duration. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7a582ca443e88ea8625584a74d664a6f6567dd19.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[list] [*]Birdseed donuts, cooldown reduction when hit increased from 2 to 4 seconds, duration increase increased from 1 to 2 seconds. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/01394ae6ab660d8f2b8eecb87756a5579245d737.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]His base attack is a bit too weak in general[/i] [list]
[*]Sword Strike, Slash damage increased from 100 to 105, Cleave lifesteal increased from 20% to 30%.
[*]Banner of the Triple Scoop, price per stage reduced from 130 to 100.
[*]Halberd of Justice, bonus damage reduced from 25% to 22%.
[*]Titanium Coneshield, price increased from 130 to 150 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments[/i] [list]
[*]Brutally Whipped Cream, price reduced from 200 to 180 per stage. [/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/713fb830953afd54abcf5557ac9a64e88e95c9a4.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b]
[list] [*]Fixed that Sentry’s Beacon no longer emitted a phone interference sound.
[*]Fixed that Starstorm statue didn't affect Bug detector. [/list]
[i]Reducing his efficiency of laying down mines in choke-points which has little to no counter-play.[/i] [list]
[*]Mines, damage while stationary reduced from 80 to 70. [/list]
[i]With this change in mind, a counter-buff to help him land reliable damage output in close ranged scenarios.[/i] [list]
[*]Mines, damage on direct hit increased from 80 to 90.
[*]Projectile speed of mines increased by 15%.[/list]
[i]Camouflage tent is currently emphasizing passive play. This change will reward aggressive use of his AA by increasing his chase potency and reliability.[/i] [list]
[*] Camouflage tent, now increases projectile speed and range by 18%, one stage for 175 solar. [/list]
[i]Drive-over skulls is also providing a lot of easy chip damage and can be replaced with a more active timing based auto-attack.[/i] [list]
[*]Drive-over skulls, now deals +75% direct damage when not firing for 1.5s. [/list]
[i]Currently Black Hole Sun feels inconsistent and very hard to avoid, and if avoided it lingers for a whole 1.5s. This is an attempt at making BHS a more reliable ability and feel more fair on both ends. Starting with rewarding precision and aim on Sentry's end while allowing enemies to dodge the skill easier.[/i] [list]
[*]Black Hole Sun, projectile distance increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, projectile speed increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, size of black hole reduced by 18%.[/list]
[i]The next set of changes are both aimed at compensating for the size reduction but also to reduce the duration of BHS.[/i] [list]
[*]Black Hole Sun, minimum gravity increased by 8%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, maximum gravity increased by 5%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, duration of black hole reduced from 1.5s to 1.2s. [/list]
[i]With these changes aside, his shield charging up also adds up a lot of time where he's difficult to punish. Reducing his shield duration both allows him for using his black hole quicker, while also being vulnerable faster.[/i] [list]
[*]Shield duration reduced from 2s to 1.5s. [/list]

[*]Black Hole Sun, Base shield increased from 20% to 25%.
[*]Microfilm, shielding reduced from 10% to 8%, price reduced to 140 solar per stage. [/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.6 to Launch April 18th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d9fd955a7a5293eaf0a400777230c05ff0e821a8.png[/img]Get ready! Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time will release on Steam this Wednesday!

The upcoming update includes a lot of balance tweaks to Derpl Zork, Qi'Tara, Commander Rocket, Dizzy, Sentry X-58, and others, as well as a number of quality of life changes.

Thanks to everyone who helped out during the Beta and shared feedback. For launch celebrations, a discussion of the changes included in the update, and some games, tune in to the Streamisho this Wednesday at 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11AM ET / 8AM PT over at Twitch.TV/RonimoGames!

notes.title: Tinker Time beta updated!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d9fd955a7a5293eaf0a400777230c05ff0e821a8.png[/img]
Hey everyone, we just released an update for the Awesomenauts 4.6: Tinker Time beta! Catch the full patch notes for this Beta compared to the current live version below.

Some of the important changes in this Beta compared to the previous Beta is that Commander Rocket no longer resets the charges on his Salvo when using Rocket Launch, some additional tweaks to Derpl and Sentry, and further changes to Professor M. Yoolip!

Please share your feedback [url=https://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]on our forums[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cf19c3b5917941055204147d2b4745161cdff74c.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b]
[i]Currently too safe and very hard to catch, Rocket needs to be easier to punish[/i][list][*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Base Health, reduced from 1150 to 1100[/list]
[i]Laser Trap is too unreliable, doing either too much damage or none at all. These changes should make its effect more reliable while also making placement a little bit more skillful.[/i][list][*]Laser Trap, time between damage ticks increased from 0.2 to 0.3.
[*]Laser Trap, damage per tick increased from 60 to 90.
[*]Laser Trap, rotation speed increased by 50%.
[*]Laser Trap, laser length reduced by 10%.
[*]Laser Trap, no longer has deployment time.
[*]Laser Trap, duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds.[/list]
[i]Some upgrade adjustments based on the above changes. These are intended to keep Rocket brawling closer to his Laser Trap.[/i][list][*]Profanity filters, now increases trap duration by 2 seconds for 160 solar.[/list]
[*]Borgo Cigar cutter, CMDR Rocket gets a shield which reduces 30% of the incoming damage as long as he is nearby a deployed laser trap.[/list]
[i]This upgrade is still too strong and mandatory[/i][list][*]Box of Cirean cigars, damage per particle per stage reduced from 20 to 16.[/list]
[i]His Rocket Launch no longer deals damage to turrets, but his turret push is still too intense. Adjusting the numbers and making them more consistent.[/i][list][*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against droids increased from 75% to 80%
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against turrets reduced from 100% to 80%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade was a holdover from a time where Rocket’s Laser Trap had a lot more uptime. The intention for this replacement is to enable Rocket to be a bit better at brawling and allowing him to stay a bit closer to the fight[/i][list][*]Head in Jar, now adds 16% damage to Charged Salvo when firing a single rocket, two stages for 175 solar each.[/list]
[i]Part of his safety comes from his relatively high ranged base attack.[/i][list][*]Charged Salvo, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Medal Booster Pack, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.[/list]
[i]Combining Rocket Launch and a full Charged Salvo at melee range provides too much damage, too easily. At the same time we want to stimulate him to get more into the thick of the fight.[/i][list][*]Rocket Launch, now deals between 150 and 350 damage, depending on how long the rocket has been flying.
[*]Mother of Bombs, after using Rocket Launch without hitting an enemy, your next Charged Salvo shot will deal 100 more damage for 170 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823d399cc943558129d3bb1f405c248306662d21.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Considered too strong specifically on Ribbit and Starstorm, these tweaks attempt to adjust him without affecting his general performance.[/i][list][*]Siege mode, Derpl is no longer immune to CC during the transformation out of siege mode.
[*]Combustion lava lamp, size increase reduced from 22% to 18%.
[*]Falling acceleration reduced by 20%.[/list]
[i]Traps can be very oppressive, maxing out at full 2.4 seconds of no gameplay for the receiving party. Their long lifetime also stimulates camping gameplay.[/i][list][*]Trap, snare duration reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds
[*]Trap, now also slows for 25% for 2.4 seconds. (extenting 1.2 seconds beyond the snare)
[*]Trap, base lifetime reduced from 11 to 9 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, snare increase per stage reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.
[*]Lead casing, the silence now has a fixed duration of 2.4 seconds.
[*]Trap, now charges in the middle of Derpl instead of having an arming time when placed.[/list]
[i]Some base attack adjustments to better balance the row and take the above changes into account.[/i][list][*]Fat Cat, cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds, price increased from 185 to 195.
[*]Kitty Catsuit, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]CAT package, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Bat Catsuit, now deals 100% increased damage against Nauts who are snared or slowed, no longer works with Fat Cat.
[*]Long Cat, now works with Fat Cat.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/306d6f4cd9cfb2e4744d49e424863f0562d72426.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Dizzy is currently a bit too strong. But she's also very finicky, and has a lot of weak upgrades.[/i][list][*]Multi Dash, time between dashes increased from 0.3 to 0.4 seconds.
[*]Multi Dash, damage per dash increased from 150 to 160.
[*]Walkbot Pro, speed up dash reload time by 30% when you are near to enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone, cooldown increased from 6 to 7 seconds.
[*]Backstage pass, increase the range of your Multi Dash by 25% when you have the maximum amount of dashes charged.
[*]Matching Glittery Dungarees, now reduces the cooldown for the next Explosive Clone by 3 seconds when it hits an enemy Awesomenaut.
[*]"Purple Prince" lipstick, now also slows enemies when they leave the bubble as well as when they are hit by the explosion.
[*]Bubble shot, size increased by 50%.
[*]Graffiti artist, price increased from 165 to 190.
[*]Tipi teal, merged to one stage of 30% range and speed increase for 140 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/89e6d6a97346b9e10bb82ea3b76823a8a1089bdc.jpg[/img][b]Ix[/b]
[i]Ix generally still brings too much to the table overall, great displace move, solid heals, invincibility frames, excellent mobility and strong brawling. In order to nudge him more towards his role his brawling should be reduced.[/i][list][*]Refract, cooldown increased from 9 to 10.
[*]Radiate, damage per Scatter reduced from 15 to 12.
[*]Mammoth hair scarf, ally speed bonus increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Tree hugger, ally damage boost increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Personality Crystal, range increase reduced from 35% to 30%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/92056c0875f58423dbc8774bae1acad1ef54924d.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Ribbit snail slime, fixed that the healthpack would time out if it fell for too long.[/list]
[i]Since these aren’t that much better than regular boots, they also don’t have to cost much more.[/i][list][*]Rocket boots, solar price reduced from 160 to 140.
[*]Base speed, increased by 4%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/32af7797f04668c4503d32c67c12e724841d75e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
[i]This item has its use, but it's too weak and expensive.[/i][list][*]From pond to podium, merged into one stage which adds 30% range and speed for 200 solar.[/list]
[i]The homing upgrade looks cool, but doesn't do much. Here is a replacement proposal.[/i][list][*]UFO spotted, now gives +50% speed during Scene Illumination for 160 solar.[/list]
[i]This upgrade is just a bit too expensive, especially given the next change.[/i][list][*]Sadak mysteries, price reduced from 195 to 175 solar.[/list]
[i]Removing the stacking will reduce the need to combo with Sadak.[/i][list][*]Brutalities of the Kraken, damage increased from 120 to 135 per stage, no longer stacks with Sadak mysteries.[/list]
[i]This item is just a bit too expensive.[/i][list][*]Rob Bourgogne, price reduced from 180 to 160 per stage.[/list]
[i]This item was overnerfed shortly after launch, because the skill was too strong to begin with at the time.[/i][list][*]Hairy King, size increase increased from 10% to 15%, price increased from 175 to 200 solar.[/list]
[i]Some overpriced items.[/i][list][*]Don Steward, price per stage reduced from 175 to 140 solar.
[*]Pete Jennirks, price reduced from 240 to 200 solar.
[*]Incriminating dirt, price reduced from 180 to 150 solar.
[*]Flying camera, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar.[/list]
[i]Meanwhile, this one's underpriced.[/i][list][*]Hidden microphone, price increased from 170 to 200 solar.[/list]
[i]This item is the strongest on the row, it doesn't need to stack further.[/i][list][*]Galactic police scanner, no longer stacks with incriminating dirt, price increased from 180 to 220 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed41d63c6b924f52411cec848bbdf99405c2cae4.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Firebreath, fixed that after being Cocooned by Genji during Firebreath she wouldn't resume after the Cocoon wears off.[/list]
[i]Some price adjustments.[/i][list][*]Skull dunduns, price reduced from 200 to 180.
[*]Eye of Coba, price reduced from from 215 to 190.
[*]Dragon Speaker Idol, now has two stages of +10% attack speed each, at 150 solar per stage.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6531b00b86ae6b0bdbc084cc9daad93c01a40cfd.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Milton Yoolip[/b]
[i]Some adjustments to improve the item balance for the gaze row.[/i][list][*]Beard Trimming Fork, price reduced from 165 to 130 solar.
[*]Syrup Pouring Robot, maximum lifesteal increased from 120 to 150 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some changes to make Dinos more reliable at base.[/i][list][*]Summon Robo Dinos, now jump at enemies at base.
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, damage per bite reduced from 80 to 75.[/list]
[i]Now this upgrade has become useless.[/i][list][*]Holo Pet Food, now reduces the damage dealt by Nauts who have been bitten by 15% for 1.5 seconds.[/list]

[b]Qi’Tara[/b][list][*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that she couldn’t use Chakram Shift to teleport while using Seven Star Strike when the Salty Seal upgrade was bought.
[*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that the Lily of the Isle projectiles would spawn at her feet during Seven Star Strike.[/list]
[i]Qi’Tara deals too much damage during Seven Star Strike, and too little outside of it.[/i][list][*]Seven star strike, attack speed increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Poisonous blade, direct damage increased from 45 to 50.[/list]
[i]Her relationship with speed feels disjointed, where attacking slows her down but Seven Star Strike speed her up etc. These changes also tie in with the issue above.[/i][list][*]Poisonous Blade, removed movement penalty when attacking.
[*]Seven Star Strike, removed speed bonus during the ability.[/list]
[i]With the changes above, this upgrade has now become useless. This change will make Qi’Tara’s damage output more reliable.[/i][list][*]Chilasi Chakram, now speeds up the damage over time of Poisonous blade by 20% for 160 solar.[/list]
[i]Since the bug was fixed where this upgrade doubled your damage, this upgrade has become too weak[/i][list][*]Lily of the Isle, projectile speed and range increased by 30%.[/list]
[i]Salty Seal makes Qi’Tara almost unstoppable, this change should make counterplay possible again[/i][list][*]Salty Seal, now cleanses all slows, snares and chains at the start of Seven Star Strike.
[*]Salty Seal, now activates a shield that blocks 100 damage and provides immunity against slows, stuns, snares, chains, gravity and time warps as long as it’s active.[/list]

[i]His Rocket Launch no longer deals damage to turrets, but his turret push is still too intense. Adjusting the numbers and making them more consistent.[/i][list][*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against droids increased from 75% to 80%
[*]Charged Salvo, damage modifier against turrets reduced from 100% to 80%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade was a holdover from a time where Rocket’s Laser Trap had a lot more uptime. The intention for this replacement is to enable Rocket to be a bit better at brawling and allowing him to stay a bit closer to the fight[/i][list][*]Head in Jar, now adds 16% damage to Charged Salvo when firing a single rocket, two stages for 175 solar each.[/list]
[i]Part of his safety comes from his relatively high ranged base attack.[/i][list][*]Charged Salvo, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Medal Booster Pack, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.[/list]
[i]Combining Rocket Launch and a full Charged Salvo at melee range provides too much damage, too easily. At the same time we want to stimulate him to get more into the thick of the fight.[/i][list][*]Rocket Launch, now deals between 150 and 350 damage, depending on how long the rocket has been flying.
[*]Mother of Bombs, after using Rocket Launch without hitting an enemy, your next Charged Salvo shot will deal 100 more damage for 170 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823d399cc943558129d3bb1f405c248306662d21.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Considered too strong specifically on Ribbit and Starstorm, these tweaks attempt to adjust him without affecting his general performance.[/i][list][*]Siege mode, Derpl is no longer immune to CC during the transformation out of siege mode.
[*]Combustion lava lamp, size increase reduced from 22% to 18%.
[*]Falling acceleration reduced by 20%.[/list]
[i]Traps can be very oppressive, maxing out at full 2.4 seconds of no gameplay for the receiving party. Their long lifetime also stimulates camping gameplay.[/i][list][*]Trap, snare duration reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds
[*]Trap, now also slows for 25% for 2.4 seconds. (extenting 1.2 seconds beyond the snare)
[*]Trap, base lifetime reduced from 11 to 9 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, snare increase per stage reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.
[*]Lead casing, the silence now has a fixed duration of 2.4 seconds.
[*]Trap, now charges in the middle of Derpl instead of having an arming time when placed.[/list]
[i]Some base attack adjustments to better balance the row and take the above changes into account.[/i][list][*]Fat Cat, cooldown increased from 4 to 5 seconds, price increased from 185 to 195.
[*]Kitty Catsuit, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]CAT package, price decreased from 175 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Bat Catsuit, now deals 100% increased damage against Nauts who are snared or slowed, no longer works with Fat Cat.
[*]Long Cat, now works with Fat Cat.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/306d6f4cd9cfb2e4744d49e424863f0562d72426.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Dizzy is currently a bit too strong. But she's also very finicky, and has a lot of weak upgrades.[/i][list][*]Multi Dash, time between dashes increased from 0.3 to 0.4 seconds.
[*]Multi Dash, damage per dash increased from 150 to 160.
[*]Walkbot Pro, speed up dash reload time by 30% when you are near to enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone, cooldown increased from 6 to 7 seconds.
[*]Backstage pass, increase the range of your Multi Dash by 25% when you have the maximum amount of dashes charged.
[*]Matching Glittery Dungarees, now reduces the cooldown for the next Explosive Clone by 3 seconds when it hits an enemy Awesomenaut.
[*]"Purple Prince" lipstick, now also slows enemies when they leave the bubble as well as when they are hit by the explosion.
[*]Bubble shot, size increased by 50%.
[*]Graffiti artist, price increased from 165 to 190.
[*]Tipi teal, merged to one stage of 30% range and speed increase for 140 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/89e6d6a97346b9e10bb82ea3b76823a8a1089bdc.jpg[/img][b]Ix[/b]
[i]Ix generally still brings too much to the table overall, great displace move, solid heals, invincibility frames, excellent mobility and strong brawling. In order to nudge him more towards his role his brawling should be reduced.[/i][list][*]Refract, cooldown increased from 9 to 10.
[*]Radiate, damage per Scatter reduced from 15 to 12.
[*]Mammoth hair scarf, ally speed bonus increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Tree hugger, ally damage boost increased from 12% to 15% per stage.
[*]Personality Crystal, range increase reduced from 35% to 30%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/92056c0875f58423dbc8774bae1acad1ef54924d.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Ribbit snail slime, fixed that the healthpack would time out if it fell for too long.[/list]
[i]Since these aren’t that much better than regular boots, they also don’t have to cost much more.[/i][list][*]Rocket boots, solar price reduced from 160 to 140.
[*]Base speed, increased by 4%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/32af7797f04668c4503d32c67c12e724841d75e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
[i]This item has its use, but it's too weak and expensive.[/i][list][*]From pond to podium, merged into one stage which adds 30% range and speed for 200 solar.[/list]
[i]The homing upgrade looks cool, but doesn't do much. Here is a replacement proposal.[/i][list][*]UFO spotted, now gives +50% speed during Scene Illumination for 160 solar.[/list]
[i]This upgrade is just a bit too expensive, especially given the next change.[/i][list][*]Sadak mysteries, price reduced from 195 to 175 solar.[/list]
[i]Removing the stacking will reduce the need to combo with Sadak.[/i][list][*]Brutalities of the Kraken, damage increased from 120 to 135 per stage, no longer stacks with Sadak mysteries.[/list]
[i]This item is just a bit too expensive.[/i][list][*]Rob Bourgogne, price reduced from 180 to 160 per stage.[/list]
[i]This item was overnerfed shortly after launch, because the skill was too strong to begin with at the time.[/i][list][*]Hairy King, size increase increased from 10% to 15%, price increased from 175 to 200 solar.[/list]
[i]Some overpriced items.[/i][list][*]Don Steward, price per stage reduced from 175 to 140 solar.
[*]Pete Jennirks, price reduced from 240 to 200 solar.
[*]Incriminating dirt, price reduced from 180 to 150 solar.
[*]Flying camera, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar.[/list]
[i]Meanwhile, this one's underpriced.[/i][list][*]Hidden microphone, price increased from 170 to 200 solar.[/list]
[i]This item is the strongest on the row, it doesn't need to stack further.[/i][list][*]Galactic police scanner, no longer stacks with incriminating dirt, price increased from 180 to 220 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed41d63c6b924f52411cec848bbdf99405c2cae4.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Firebreath, fixed that after being Cocooned by Genji during Firebreath she wouldn't resume after the Cocoon wears off.[/list]
[i]Some price adjustments.[/i][list][*]Skull dunduns, price reduced from 200 to 180.
[*]Eye of Coba, price reduced from from 215 to 190.
[*]Dragon Speaker Idol, now has two stages of +10% attack speed each, at 150 solar per stage.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6531b00b86ae6b0bdbc084cc9daad93c01a40cfd.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Milton Yoolip[/b]
[i]Some adjustments to improve the item balance for the gaze row.[/i][list][*]Beard Trimming Fork, price reduced from 165 to 130 solar.
[*]Syrup Pouring Robot, maximum lifesteal increased from 120 to 150 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some changes to make Dinos more reliable at base.[/i][list][*]Summon Robo Dinos, now jump at enemies at base.
[*]Summon Robo Dinos, damage per bite reduced from 80 to 75.[/list]
[i]Now this upgrade has become useless.[/i][list][*]Holo Pet Food, now reduces the damage dealt by Nauts who have been bitten by 15% for 1.5 seconds.[/list]

[b]Qi’Tara[/b][list][*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that she couldn’t use Chakram Shift to teleport while using Seven Star Strike when the Salty Seal upgrade was bought.
[*]Made Qi'Taras seven star strike visual only in front of Qi'Tara to represent the area where damage was being applied better.
[*]Fixed that the Lily of the Isle projectiles would spawn at her feet during Seven Star Strike.[/list]
[i]Qi’Tara deals too much damage during Seven Star Strike, and too little outside of it.[/i][list][*]Seven star strike, attack speed increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Poisonous blade, direct damage increased from 45 to 50.[/list]
[i]Her relationship with speed feels disjointed, where attacking slows her down but Seven Star Strike speed her up etc. These changes also tie in with the issue above.[/i][list][*]Poisonous Blade, removed movement penalty when attacking.
[*]Seven Star Strike, removed speed bonus during the ability.[/list]
[i]With the changes above, this upgrade has now become useless. This change will make Qi’Tara’s damage output more reliable.[/i][list][*]Chilasi Chakram, now speeds up the damage over time of Poisonous blade by 20% for 160 solar.[/list]
[i]Since the bug was fixed where this upgrade doubled your damage, this upgrade has become too weak[/i][list][*]Lily of the Isle, projectile speed and range increased by 30%.[/list]
[i]Salty Seal makes Qi’Tara almost unstoppable, this change should make counterplay possible again[/i][list][*]Salty Seal, now cleanses all slows, snares and chains at the start of Seven Star Strike.
[*]Salty Seal, now activates a shield that blocks 100 damage and provides immunity against slows, stuns, snares, chains, gravity and time warps as long as it’s active.[/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments.[/i][list][*]Seven star strike, now also gives a 10% lifesteal effect.
[*]Baby plumbin oil, additional lifesteal reduced from 30% to 15% for 175 solar.
[*]Rakki Comb, merged to one stage which adds 200% damage vs. droids for 155 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c3e6b9ea5315191e6b97f4d8f5951b5c8162cf62.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list][*]Iron Rifle, fixed that the shield didn’t last long enough to protect the entire charge duration.[/list]
[i]This weak upgrade has some heavy competition on the row.[/i][list][*]Monkey hand, range increase increased from 25% to 40%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7a582ca443e88ea8625584a74d664a6f6567dd19.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b][list][*]Birdseed donuts, cooldown reduction when hit increased from 2 to 4 seconds, duration increase increased from 1 to 2 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/01394ae6ab660d8f2b8eecb87756a5579245d737.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]His base attack is a bit too weak in general[/i][list][*]Sword Strike, Slash damage increased from 100 to 105, Cleave lifesteal increased from 20% to 30%.
[*]Banner of the Triple Scoop, price per stage reduced from 130 to 100.
[*]Halberd of Justice, bonus damage reduced from 25% to 22%.
[*]Titanium Coneshield, price increased from 130 to 150 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Other tweaks and adjustments[/i][list][*]Brutally Whipped Cream, price reduced from 200 to 180 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/713fb830953afd54abcf5557ac9a64e88e95c9a4.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Fixed that Sentry’s Beacon no longer emitted a phone interference sound.
[*]Fixed that Starstorm statue didn't affect Bug detector.[/list]
[i]Reducing his efficiency of laying down mines in choke-points which has little to no counter-play.[/i][list][*]Mines, damage while stationary reduced from 80 to 70.[/list]
[i]With this change in mind, a counter-buff to help him land reliable damage output in close ranged scenarios.[/i][list][*]Mines, damage on direct hit increased from 80 to 90.
[*]Projectile speed of mines increased by 15%.[/list]
[i]Camouflage tent is currently emphasizing passive play. This change will reward aggressive use of his AA by increasing his chase potency and reliability.[/i][list][*]Camouflage tent, now increases projectile speed and range by 15%, one stage for 175 solar.[/list]
[i]Drive-over skulls is also providing a lot of easy chip damage and can be replaced with a more active timing based auto-attack.[/i][list][*]Drive-over skulls, now deals +75% direct damage when not firing for 1.5s.[/list]
[i]Currently Black Hole Sun feels inconsistent and very hard to avoid, and if avoided it lingers for a whole 1.5s. This is an attempt at making BHS a more reliable ability and feel more fair on both ends. Starting with rewarding precision and aim on Sentry's end while allowing enemies to dodge the skill easier.[/i][list][*]Black Hole Sun, projectile distance increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, projectile speed increased by 10%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, size of black hole reduced by 15%.[/list]
[i]The next set of changes are both aimed at compensating for the size reduction but also to reduce the duration of BHS.[/i][list][*]Black Hole Sun, minimum gravity increased by 8%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, maximum gravity increased by 5%.
[*]Black Hole Sun, duration of black hole reduced from 1.5s to 1.2s.[/list]
[i]With these changes aside, his shield charging up also adds up a lot of time where he's difficult to punish. Reducing his shield duration both allows him for using his black hole quicker, while also being vulnerable faster.[/i][list][*]Shield duration reduced from 2s to 1.5s.[/list]
[i]With less up-time of his shields, his base shield scaling could be increased to fulfill his tanky role. This allows him to tank a little extra in fights and reward aggressive play.[/i][list][*]Black Hole Sun, Base shield increased from 20% to 25%.
[*]Microfilm, shielding reduced from 10% to 8%, price reduced to 140 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Some Sentry's just leave their beacon sitting somewhere in order to reveal or permanently put pressure on an area.[/i][list][*]Teleport Beacon, times out after 45 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/533ccae8a301b7a6bcef4fbf5a4f4d898dd7768d.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Made separate spawnpoints for Sawblade and Spare blade, and moved them apart a little.
[*]Sawblade, now deals direct damage instead of damage over time.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/033fc68a9b5c59a6506c8ae4255a147a60ccc750.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b]
[i]Smiles has been overnerfed in the last few updates.[/i][list][*]Base health, increased from 1550 to 1650.
[*]Trapper’s hook, cooldown reduced from 10 to 8 seconds.
[*]Bush fire, range increased by 25%.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/36aa2148c877b5ffaaec29de1e2eb29778af0b34.jpg[/img]
[b]Swiggins[/b][list][*]Poolboy, price reduced from 240 to 210 solar.[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/04d99daf1b3c440ab3cc1dcc537d922ea50d6a19.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b][list][*]Uranium spikes, price increased from 125 to 150 per stage.[/list]

notes.title: Tentative Balance Changes for Update 4.6
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/325ac1bb03e68eb4dc93b64b163a9e77620082a1.png[/img]Hey everyone, as we continue to take community input for the upcoming balance & bug fixing update, our designer Jasper has published a document containing tentative balance changes we're planning to introduce in the upcoming Beta. The document is open to comments, and we'd love to get a little more input on these intended changes before we fully implement them.

You can find the document here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ntn7YLoROFB11CTb2tBgI9efuWgvaE2p7ZSmC9vKaZQ/

Please use the comment feature in Google Docs to share your thoughts and provide additional input to the suggestions of other players, but keep it civilized!

Some of the more exciting changes currently lined up include the transformation of Professor M. Yoolip's Wrench Smack to a ranged Wrench Fling attack, multiple tweaks to upgrades for Qi'Tara and Commander Rocket, and changes to the way Turret Mode and Trap placement work for Derpl.

Furthermore, you can share thoughts on some proposed changes to different upgrades in a different sheet, over here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1x_v6Ba9DR--XlP4kXZXEyaFdx-T74vJjiHxWOAczwao/. These changes are currently under consideration but have not yet made it into the list for 'planned' changes, so share your input there as well!

notes.title: Taking input for Update 4.6 Balance Improvements!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/823e6273ceccc808072f281caee869a568e6e153.png[/img]Hey everyone! We're currently working on Awesomenauts 4.6, an update that will bring balance tweaks and a bunch of bug fixes!

18-12-2017

notes.title: Hotfix 4.5.1 now live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/489d32791ab1f763de64be2c42b3210cbbd6ab70.png[/img]We just released Awesomenauts 4.5.1 with fixes for some Qi'Tara issues that have been reported since she released on Wednesday, as well as some fixes for problems related to the new bundles. Full patch notes are included below.

While this update fixes a significant number of issues that have been reported so far, we have additional improvements currently in development and will be releasing them in an additional update next week.

Please continue to report issues you encounter [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13]on our forums[/url], so that we can investigate and address them as soon as possible.

That said, have a great weekend, and enjoy the latest update and Randomnauts Brawl!

[h1]Hotfix 4.5.1[/h1]
[b]General[/b][list][*]Added a profile portrait for the Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara skin, and made it available to players that own the skin.[/list]

[b]Interface[/b][list][*]The skin bundle button in the armory now correctly links to the appropriate skin bundle Steam store page.
[*]Added a skin bundle button to Chucho Krok’s Armory page.
[*]Fixed that the button tooltip for bundle buttons listed the incorrect announcer in some languages.
[*]Fixed that the Starter Pack price did not show correctly in the Armory, and in the Starter Pack popup that displays when you unlock a Starter Pack naut.
[*]Removed unintended display of the Ksenia skin bundle button in the Announcer Armory.
[*]Fixed that some menu tiles had unintentional scrolling functionality.
[*]Fixed that some announcer names would not fit inside their button in the Armory Announcer browser.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d015210e3aa4a17bd76d321a299a1accba7415a6.jpg[/img]
[b]Qi’Tara[/b][list][*]Chakram shift, fixed an issue where the icon for the skill disappeared and the skill became unusable until Qi’Tara died.
[*]Chakram shift, fixed that when an enemy Naut would die while carrying a chakram Qi’Tara would still see the arrow as she could shift to that position.
[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed that if you activated Lily’s effect by hitting an enemy Naut with a Chakram, and then activated Seven star strike, you’d get both a melee and ranged attack. This effectively allowed you to double your damage output.
[*]Lily of the Isle, fixed an issue where Qi'Tara wouldn't show an attack animation during Seven star strike once the Lily of the Ilse upgrade effect wore off.
[*]Seven Star Strike, fixed an issue where Qi’Tara would die instantly from chain effects like Swiggin’s Anchor Drop or Smiles Trapper’s Hook while Seven Star Strike was active and after buying the Salty Seal upgrade.
[*]Qi’Tara’s standard melee attack now prefers nauts and droids over turrets. Because Qi’Tara’s melee attack is single target this should help her clear enemies inside a turret while pushing.[/list]

[b]Known issue[/b]: holding down the Charkram button when the skill comes off cooldown may cause elements of the ability to desync. Waiting for the cooldown to fully reset if this occurs will resolve this issue. This will be addressed in a future update.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f0b18d74dc6fd311d9352c0acf2313e407ceaec4.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Grey man group badge, fixed that the full bar sound would play on every hit once the bar was filled.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bd4aa0fb5482f41b266ce97739083f0c1712c80f.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list][*]Weapon switch, fixed an issue where if skill aiming graphics were enabled, stimpack was active, the airstrike button was held, and Ted switches from machine gun to shotgun that the switching time was doubled.[/list]
