notes.title: Revenge of the Renegades NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/489d32791ab1f763de64be2c42b3210cbbd6ab70.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades is now available on Steam, and that means Qi'Tara is now available! The update also adds five new profile portraits to the mix, a number of additional features and tools for the in-game level editor, and much more.

Qi'Tara, the thirty-third playable Awesomenaut, is a cloaked assassin that applies a stacking poison effect to her enemies every time she hits them. Her individual hits don’t deal too much damage, but the poison effect can quickly overwhelm her opponents because of her high attack speed.

Owners of the Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack should have Qi'Tara unlocked right away, while everyone else can unlock her with 10.000 Awesomepoints, or by purchasing her from the Steam store. http://store.steampowered.com/app/561561
Alongside Qi'Tara, we're releasing an awesome premium skin called Dark Masquerade Qi'Tara as well as a brand-new announcer called Renegade Command. http://store.steampowered.com/app/634014 http://store.steampowered.com/app/399835 Furthermore, we're introducing a new Starter Pack in this update. The Starter Pack contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

For full patch notes, check the bottom of this post.

Already own some of the 'Nauts contained in the Starter Pack? Don't worry, as the game will automatically refund you the Awesomepoint-value of any duplicate characters you already possess prior to pruchasing the pack. The pack is available at $7.99 and to celebrate the release of Update 4.5 it's temporarily discounted by 20%.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/425541 Last but not least, we're introducing a number of new 'Complete-the-set' bundles on Steam to allow players to obtain all available content for their favorite characters at a 20% discount. Check out the in-game armory for more information.

[h1][b]Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades[/b][/h1]
[i]15-11-2017[/i]

[b]NEW character: Qi’Tara[/b]
[i]Being a Chilasi princess, it surprised everyone when Qi’Tara joined the Scargi military. After all, the Chilasi of Gromdom and the snail-like Scargi had been at war for decades in an attempt to settle an ancient dispute: whether the Splumbs that grow in the many gardens on their planet are a fruit, or whether they’re in fact a vegetable, as the Scargi maintained. Despite all that, she quickly rose through the ranks to become a royal guard in the Order of the Scargi Emperor and attained the title of Femme Fatale Haricot Beurre. Some say she seduced the Scargi emperor to provoke her father, the king, while others say she just did it to access the Scargi Shplumb reserves.[/i]

Abilities:
[list][*]Poisonous Blades: Slash and inflict a stacking poison onto your enemies.
[*]Seven Star Strike: Temporarily gain the ability to slash rapidly around you.
[*]Chakram Shift: Throw out a Chakram that sticks to your enemies and warp to it with a second press.[/list]
[b]NEW skin: Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara [/b]
[i]Serving as a member of the Order of the Scargi Emperor, Qi'Tara sometimes has to go undercover and blend into the crowd to protect Emperor Piere Feu Darret. Being a Chilasi (and armed to the teeth), that's rarely an easy feat. As a result, these tasks are usually left to other members of her Order when opportunities alow.

Once a year though, during the national Splumb Carnival, Qi'Tara mingles with the splumb-covered, masked partygoers - marvelling many with what they think is an elaborate Chilasi-costume. The only ones that find out she's not just PRETENDING to be a heavily armed Chilasi warrior are the would-be assassins she encounters.

For Qi'Tara the Splumb Carnival is the best day of the year as it allows her to indulge into her two favorite things: splumbs and murder.[/i]

The Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara skin comes equipped with a fully customized voice set, and owning the skin will unlock a special portrait for use in-game.

[b]NEW: Renegade Command Announcer[/b]
[i]You've got the plan.
You've got the weapons.
You've got the explosives.
You might even have an inside man to get you through the front door and into the facility.
But none of that makes you a Renegade.
For that, you need style. And a narrator.
Let the Renegade Command announcer turn every mission you go on into something special.[/i]

[b]NEW: Awesomenauts Starter pack[/b]
To help new players get started with Awesomenauts, we’re introducing a brand new Starter Pack. This bundle contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

Already own one or more of the characters included in this pack? Don't worry! We'll give you the in-game Awesomepoint value for any of the characters you already own, giving you a jumpstart to unlocking other Awesomenauts. 

[b]NEW: Character Bundles[/b]
To help players obtain skins and relevant announcers for their favorite characters, we’re now offering Complete-the-set bundles on Steam that allow players to obtain content at a discount. Check out the armory to learn more about the bundles we have available!

[b]Profile Portraits[/b][list][*]Step right up!
[*]Look at that!
[*]Dobl Dicey
[*]Time-lost Slipper
[*]Rocket toaster[/list]
[b]NEW: Animation editor[/b]
[i]Added the animation editor to the modding tools![/i][list][*]While modding a map you can now open the animation editor with F3.
[*]Just like normal animations, modded animations can be used in maps and can be triggered by AI.
[*]The animation editor features a timeline, parenting and keyframes to create more complex animations. -Through the animation editor you can also put sounds, text and rumble in your levels.
[*]At the moment you can’t add custom sounds so you need to use the sounds that are already in the game.
[*]At the moment you can only add newlines and special characters to Text objects by pasting them from Notepad, since the text field won’t accept them directly.
[*]Due to memory constraints voices are only played if the character/skin/announcer is actually in the match, so for example you can’t use Lonestar’s voice in a mod if there’s no Lonestar in the match. This only goes for voices: sound effects can always be played.[/list]
[b]Behaviour editor[/b][list][*]When reloading ai’s it will also respawn the selected character. This makes testing of behaviour changes easier.
[*]New behaviour option: isTargetInRangeOfSKill. This will check if the behaviour target is in range of a specific skill.
[*]A number of game variables are now directly available inside the behaviour editor. The list is mentioned in the help popup of the behaviour editor. The current variables are: character.width, character.height, character.maxHealth, character.position.x, character.position.y
[*]Area search blocks have two extra parameters to align the search area against the character. These settings are: ‘horizontal alignment to character’ and ‘vertical alignment to character’.[/list]
[b]General[/b][list][*]Skill aiming visuals are now correct when aiming behind you.
[*]Added a team-switch area to the Test Map.
[*]Commander Rocket is now available at 7500 Awesomepoints.[/list]
[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Further lowered the platform in the hiding area in front of the turret in order to make jumping onto more consistently possible.[/list]

notes.title: Revenge of the Renegades NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/489d32791ab1f763de64be2c42b3210cbbd6ab70.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades is now available on Steam, and that means Qi'Tara is now available! The update also adds five new profile portraits to the mix, a number of additional features and tools for the in-game level editor, and much more.

Qi'Tara, the thirty-third playable Awesomenaut, is a cloaked assassin that applies a stacking poison effect to her enemies every time she hits them. Her individual hits don’t deal too much damage, but the poison effect can quickly overwhelm her opponents because of her high attack speed.

Owners of the Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack should have Qi'Tara unlocked right away, while everyone else can unlock her with 10.000 Awesomepoints, or by purchasing her from the Steam store. http://store.steampowered.com/app/561561
Alongside Qi'Tara, we're releasing an awesome premium skin called Dark Masquerade Qi'Tara as well as a brand-new announcer called Renegade Command. http://store.steampowered.com/app/634014 http://store.steampowered.com/app/399835 Furthermore, we're introducing a new Starter Pack in this update. The Starter Pack contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

For full patch notes, check the bottom of this post.

Already own some of the 'Nauts contained in the Starter Pack? Don't worry, as the game will automatically refund you the Awesomepoint-value of any duplicate characters you already possess prior to pruchasing the pack. The pack is available at $7.99 and to celebrate the release of Update 4.5 it's temporarily discounted by 20%.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/425541 Last but not least, we're introducing a number of new 'Complete-the-set' bundles on Steam to allow players to obtain all available content for their favorite characters at a 20% discount. Check out the in-game armory for more information.

[h1][b]Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades[/b][/h1]
[i]15-11-2017[/i]

[b]NEW character: Qi’Tara[/b]
[i]Being a Chilasi princess, it surprised everyone when Qi’Tara joined the Scargi military. After all, the Chilasi of Gromdom and the snail-like Scargi had been at war for decades in an attempt to settle an ancient dispute: whether the Splumbs that grow in the many gardens on their planet are a fruit, or whether they’re in fact a vegetable, as the Scargi maintained. Despite all that, she quickly rose through the ranks to become a royal guard in the Order of the Scargi Emperor and attained the title of Femme Fatale Haricot Beurre. Some say she seduced the Scargi emperor to provoke her father, the king, while others say she just did it to access the Scargi Shplumb reserves.[/i]

Abilities:
[list][*]Poisonous Blades: Slash and inflict a stacking poison onto your enemies.
[*]Seven Star Strike: Temporarily gain the ability to slash rapidly around you.
[*]Chakram Shift: Throw out a Chakram that sticks to your enemies and warp to it with a second press.[/list]
[b]NEW skin: Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara [/b]
[i]Serving as a member of the Order of the Scargi Emperor, Qi'Tara sometimes has to go undercover and blend into the crowd to protect Emperor Piere Feu Darret. Being a Chilasi (and armed to the teeth), that's rarely an easy feat. As a result, these tasks are usually left to other members of her Order when opportunities alow.

Once a year though, during the national Splumb Carnival, Qi'Tara mingles with the splumb-covered, masked partygoers - marvelling many with what they think is an elaborate Chilasi-costume. The only ones that find out she's not just PRETENDING to be a heavily armed Chilasi warrior are the would-be assassins she encounters.

For Qi'Tara the Splumb Carnival is the best day of the year as it allows her to indulge into her two favorite things: splumbs and murder.[/i]

The Dark Masquerade Qi’Tara skin comes equipped with a fully customized voice set, and owning the skin will unlock a special portrait for use in-game.

[b]NEW: Renegade Command Announcer[/b]
[i]You've got the plan.
You've got the weapons.
You've got the explosives.
You might even have an inside man to get you through the front door and into the facility.
But none of that makes you a Renegade.
For that, you need style. And a narrator.
Let the Renegade Command announcer turn every mission you go on into something special.[/i]

[b]NEW: Awesomenauts Starter pack[/b]
To help new players get started with Awesomenauts, we’re introducing a brand new Starter Pack. This bundle contains eight accessible characters that highlight various roles and playstyles, and is sure to contain a great line-up for players looking dive deeper into everything Awesomenauts has to offer.

Already own one or more of the characters included in this pack? Don't worry! We'll give you the in-game Awesomepoint value for any of the characters you already own, giving you a jumpstart to unlocking other Awesomenauts. 

[b]NEW: Character Bundles[/b]
To help players obtain skins and relevant announcers for their favorite characters, we’re now offering Complete-the-set bundles on Steam that allow players to obtain content at a discount. Check out the armory to learn more about the bundles we have available!

[b]Profile Portraits[/b][list][*]Step right up!
[*]Look at that!
[*]Dobl Dicey
[*]Time-lost Slipper
[*]Rocket toaster[/list]
[b]NEW: Animation editor[/b]
[i]Added the animation editor to the modding tools![/i][list][*]While modding a map you can now open the animation editor with F3.
[*]Just like normal animations, modded animations can be used in maps and can be triggered by AI.
[*]The animation editor features a timeline, parenting and keyframes to create more complex animations. -Through the animation editor you can also put sounds, text and rumble in your levels.
[*]At the moment you can’t add custom sounds so you need to use the sounds that are already in the game.
[*]At the moment you can only add newlines and special characters to Text objects by pasting them from Notepad, since the text field won’t accept them directly.
[*]Due to memory constraints voices are only played if the character/skin/announcer is actually in the match, so for example you can’t use Lonestar’s voice in a mod if there’s no Lonestar in the match. This only goes for voices: sound effects can always be played.[/list]
[b]Behaviour editor[/b][list][*]When reloading ai’s it will also respawn the selected character. This makes testing of behaviour changes easier.
[*]New behaviour option: isTargetInRangeOfSKill. This will check if the behaviour target is in range of a specific skill.
[*]A number of game variables are now directly available inside the behaviour editor. The list is mentioned in the help popup of the behaviour editor. The current variables are: character.width, character.height, character.maxHealth, character.position.x, character.position.y
[*]Area search blocks have two extra parameters to align the search area against the character. These settings are: ‘horizontal alignment to character’ and ‘vertical alignment to character’.[/list]
[b]General[/b][list][*]Skill aiming visuals are now correct when aiming behind you.
[*]Added a team-switch area to the Test Map.
[*]Commander Rocket is now available at 7500 Awesomepoints.[/list]
[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Further lowered the platform in the hiding area in front of the turret in order to make jumping onto more consistently possible.[/list]

notes.title: Last chance to get the All Nauts Pack!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/4aa85ccffe0dd20beb688146ea6dad5079d18edd.png[/img]As we previously announced, the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/]Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack[/url] is being retired when Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades launches. In this update, it will be replaced with a brand-new Starter Pack.

We're currently in final stages of testing the update, and if all goes according to plan the update will hit tomorrow, on December 6th. That means this will be your final chance to obtain the Awesomenauts All Nauts Pack, which grants you immediate access to all characters as well as access to new characters as they are released.

The All Nauts Pack is currently available at 40% off as a 'going-away sale':
http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/
The Starter Pack, which will launch alongside Update 4.5, contains eight accessible characters that each highlight a different playstyle. This allows newer players to get a headstart as they dive into all the content that Awesomenauts has to offer, and grants them an Awesomepoint-refund for any characters they already own.

The eight characters included in the Starter Pack are:[list][*][b]Rocco[/b] - the arrow-slinging assassin
[*][b]Coco Nebulon[/b] - the waveboard-riding harasser
[*][b]Sheriff Lonestar[/b] - the gunslinger that excels at pushing lanes
[*][b]Professor M. Yoolip[/b] - the wrench-wielding, dinosaur-summoning support
[*][b]Leon Chameleon[/b] - the backstabbing assassin
[*][b]Max Focus[/b] - the flying Awesomenaut that harasses enemies from a distance
[*][b]Genji the Pollen Prophet[/b] - the shielding support 'Naut that can cocoon his enemies
[*][b]The Scoop of Justice[/b] - the versatile warrior with incredible sustain[/list]

A Linux version of the update will be released tomorrow.

For info on how to access the Open Beta, please head over to [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]our official forums[/url].

At this time, Awesomenauts 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades is scheduled for a release on December 6th.

The patch notes for Beta Update 1 are included below.

[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Further lowered the platform in the hiding area in front of the turret in order to make jumping onto more consistently possible.[/list]

notes.title: Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades - Now in OPEN BETA
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/289cef3f4379e5291eb9e60750e25a42c82e4ab1.png[/img]Qi'Tara has been preparing her blades for a little while now, and is now one step closer to joining the Awesomenauts! Try her out in the open beta right now and share your feedback on [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]the official Awesomenauts forums[/url]!

In Update 4.5: Revenge of the Renegades we'll finally have all the members of Rocket's Renegades reunited as members of the Awesomenauts. Qi'Tara complements the team as an incredibly agile assassin that excels at chasing down her victims.

This update also brings a cool new feature to the Level Editor: the animation editor! This new tools gives players the ability to create elaborate animations, and it's the same tool the developers use for many of the in-game effects.

For a complete list of what's new, please [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=51766]check out the patch notes for this first beta[/url]. For a guide on how to access the open beta, [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]please visit our official forums[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/619335c0e4c6925b02e1011476747bd3f6adbcb6.png[/img]In addition to bringing a new character and this upgrade for the level editor, Update 4.5 will also bring a couple of changes to the different types of content-bundles we have available right now.

Based on a lot of data and user feedback we will be replacing the All Nauts Pack when Update 4.5 launches! In it's place will be a new Starter Pack that's cheaper and more player-friendly, while also keeping the sense of progression intact.

Of course, players who already own the All Nauts Pack will continue to receive new characters as they release - so this change won't impact existing owners in any way.

Furthermore, we'll also be replacing the Costume Parties with a new type of bundle when the update launches. Since the game has gone free to play, not all players have access to the same characters anymore and having a fixed pack of skins for various characters no longer makes as much sense. In the weeks ahead, we'll detail the new Starter Pack and the new skin bundles. 

We'll let you know at least two weeks in advance before the All Nauts Pack and Costume Party packs actually retired, so stay tuned for more news. If you've been holding out on the All Nauts Pack you'll probably want to pick it up in the coming weeks before it's too late!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/561527/Awesomenauts_All_Nauts_pack/

notes.title: First Qi'Tara teaser images!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/1325b8c86be4a203abf321869b15b8293be65c3f.jpg[/img]With Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee live for two weeks, we're slowly turning our attention to the next update for Awesomenauts. We're hard at work to finish Qi'Tara, the fourth Renegade to join the Awesomenauts, and will be giving you all a gameplay demo during the next Streamisho on November 2nd.

For now, we do have a couple of teaser images that highlight some of the new skills for this mysterious 'Naut!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/acd55aa925c36057405674dfc17b723c91786d12.jpg[/img]

Qi'Tara is shaping up to a great new addition to the cast, and we can't wait to show you more. Stay tuned for more teases over the coming weeks, and a full reveal on November 2nd!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2cb06f5aa5a43974e519a03dd52ad4d14fbfee33.jpg[/img]
In the meantime, don't forget to log in this weekend for a new Brawl! This week we're playing Team Deathmatch, which pits your team against three players on a small map with very few opportunities to escape or heal!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.4.2 NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Hey everyone, we just released Update 4.4.2, which addresses several of the remaining bugs from our last update and makes improvements to the stability of Brawls. As always, please let us know about issues by reporting them in the Support section of our forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13

Thanks for helping us iron out the last couple of issues over the last week, and we hope you have a blast with the latest update :)

[h1][b]Update 4.4.2[/b][/h1]
17-10-2017

[b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed that 2 missions would be granted after a day rather than 1
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when quitting the game
[*]Fixed incorrect display of ‘M_PartySlot_DownloadingMods’ when locked out of matchmaking
[*]Unlocked Raelynn for recruits who didn’t unlock her when they were first recruited
[*]Added some UI elements and effects to Daily Mission UI to better clarify that only 1 Daily Mission will appear per day.
[*]Fixed that the brawl timer tooltip that appears when hovering over the Brawl button in the Play menu sometimes showed incorrect brawl ETA.
[*]Fixed that quitting the game sometimes took very long
[*]Fixed that it was possible to play with other nauts than Rocco in the Tip Top Brawl, and prevented the same from happening in similar Brawls.
[*]Fixed that players could make custom changes to Brawls[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Box of cirean cigars, fixed that the second stage did nothing.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][list][*]Derpl should no longer fire his Nuke from his feet.
[*]Nuke, fixed an issue where it was possible to desync the charging and firing of the Nuke.
[*]Tweaked Derpl’s visual indicator to show the area in which Derpl’s nuke deals damage.
[*]Deployment Pads, fixed that the knockback pulse sometimes wouldn't trigger.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list][*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, no longer applies to allied droids.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, no longer applies to allied droids.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that it didn’t kill enemy droids when playing as team blue.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that the gold from the killed droid wouldn’t fly to Genji.
[*]The last pieridae transformae, fixed that a droid would spawn and despawn whenever a floor or ceiling was hit by cocoon.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list][*]Overexposed nature photo, fixed that the upgrade would still extend the duration bar shown during bond.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list][*]
[*]Micey the Mech-pilot, fixed that the knockback pulse wouldn't trigger correctly when the skill isn't cancelled.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list][*]-Galactic police scanner, fixed that it didn’t stack correctly with Incriminating dirt and Addresses of the Stars![/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Orb of Omicron, fixed that the orb sometimes wouldn't spawn.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Tweaked Penny Fox’s visual indicator to show the area and trajectory in which Pulse deals damage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yoolip_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Professor Yoolip[/b][list][*]Badly washed lab coat, fixed that the cooldown effect was also triggered by hitting turrets.
[*]Laboratory Centrifuge, affected droids now drop healthpacks again.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list][*]Fixed that Soulhuntress’ Raelynn’s trail would show up when invisible.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Circuits of Time, fixed that the upgrade wouldn't create a clone.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Steeldrum, fixed tooltip stat.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash with Fistbump upgrade can now deflect projectiles again.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b][list][*]Shotgun, fixed that it was possible to shoot at the same time as activating stimpack. This resulted in a shotgun blast from Ted’s feet.
[*]Angel wing toilet paper, fixed that activating stimpack and teleporting at the same time while in possession of this upgrade would keep your shotgun filled up during the stimpack’s effect.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b][list][*]Tweaked Vinnie & Spike’s visual indicator to show the area in which Spike Dive deals damage.[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b][list][*]Purchasing Dead Seahorse Head causes the skill visualization of Spike Dive to remain fixed in the level until cast again or casting Smoke Screen.
[*]Not all skill visualizations accurately predict the range of an ability when targetting behind you.[/list]

notes.title: Free Naut Rotation for Week 41
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/0837dffeda0394d4ccb8bef228cb2369b8731fde.jpg[/img]A new week, a new set of 'Nauts available for free in our weekly rotation. This week, sneak around and get the jump on your enemies with Leon Chameleon, or spike-dive into battle with Vinnie & Spike. Use Sentry X-58, one of the original Starstorm 'Nauts, to dominate the battlefield with his versatile teleport ability and Black Hole Sun attack.

The final character available in this rotation, Rocco, also has a special role to play in the next Weekly Brawl... so if you're not familiar with him yet you might want to play a couple practice games with him to get ready for the weekend!

All these characters are available to all players with account level 6 or higher, and can be played in all game modes until the end of the week. Enjoy, and let us know whether any of these are your new favorites!

All these characters are available to all players with account level 6 or higher, and can be played in all game modes until the end of the week. Enjoy, and let us know whether any of these are your new favorites!

notes.title: Patch notes for Update 4.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is now available! The patch notes for this update are included below, but [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1469721435682506733]we've posted a more reader-friendly summary of what's included in this update in another announcement.[/url]

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the latest Awesomenauts update!

[h1]Update 4.4[/h1]
Released on 5-10-2017

[b]NEW: Brawls[/b]
Patch 4.4 introduces a brand new matchmaking game mode: Brawls![quote]Brawls will present limited time opportunities to play with and against other players in special matchmade bouts with unique rulesets. From regular Awesomenauts matches on weird new maps to triple damage team deathmatch with only Rocco’s, Brawl is set up to spice up and diversify your Awesomenauts experience. 

We’ve seen a lot of players enjoying many wacky and weird game modes in custom games. There’s even been some very fun to watch tournaments (King of the Frogs comes to mind). Brawl will make that experience accessible by adding matchmaking, and rewards. Brawl will be a highly accessible purefun™ gamemode. Some characters might be grossly overpowered in some of these game modes, but in brawls that’s part of the fun!

Brawls will award Awesomepoints and experience, just like regular matches. The first 3 brawl matches, though, will award 4 times as much![/quote][b]NEW: Daily  Missions[/b]
Daily missions are random objectives that will award you with Awesomepoints when you complete them. You can have up to 3 Daily Missions available to you and a brand new mission will appear each day.[quote]Daily Missions will appear in the main menu and will have various different types of objectives and reward amounts. Some missions might require you to play a random character, while others will ask you to deal a specified amount of damage to enemy turrets. You will be able to complete these objectives in both the Co-op versus Bots and Online Match game modes.

To keep overall Awesomepoints gain the same now that Daily Missions are introduced, Awesomepoints gain for matches has been reduced.[/quote]
[b]NEW: Main Menu Tiles[/b]
Main Menu Tiles are banners in the main menu that point you to various aspects of the game. The game will try to figure out what kind of information is appropriate for you and will then show a tile for it. For example, tiles will alert you when a character is close to leveling up, or advise a certain game mode.

[b]NEW: Skill aiming visuals[/b]
In order to help players see where their skills will end up, we’ve added aiming visuals for almost all of them. Some characters already had these visuals, like the Lunge for Deadlift or skills which require charging such as Lonestar’s Dynamite. Now when you hold down the action button to trigger a skill, you’ll see it’s effect visualized in the game. Letting go will then trigger the skill. Of course if you feel you don’t need it and want skills to trigger just that bit faster, you can turn it off in the settings.

Known issues:
[list][*]Penny dash distance prediction not accurate
[*]Clunk bite aim shown on wrong side of character when aiming backwards
[*]Froggy dash icon is not shown as disabled while tornado is active[/list]

[b]NEW premium skin: Soulhuntress Raelynn[/b]
[quote][i]Whoever said 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend' sure never met Soulhuntress Raelynn. Though she spends her days hunting demons, cultists, and other evil scum (which lots of folk appreciate), she's not particularly nice company at parties and friendly get-togethers. One time she attended a feast some villagers organized in her honor and she used her laser rifle to 'cleanse' the demon-shaped chocolate cake the villagers had spent days to prepare for her in secret. In the end, she's just not a people person, and most people have learned to leave her alone and not invite her to their parties.

She is GREAT friends with Cuddles though. Together they've cleansed more demons and other evildoers from this world than you'd feel comfortable knowing. And a chocolate cake.[/i][/quote]

This is a paid DLC and comes with a fully customized voice set and a portrait! http://store.steampowered.com/app/605940/Awesomenauts__Soulhuntress_Raelynn_Skin/

[b]NEW announcer: Ringmaster Announcer[/b]
[quote][i]Ladies and Gentlenauts, welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! It's a brand new show in the greatest big top of the galaxy. Step right up, step right up!

The Zork family is proud to present you tonight's entertainment: a feast of slaughter, daring adventures, and violence! We'll keep you on the edge of your seat as the intrepid heroes perform for you in our Circus. Witness the marvel of twenty Nauts plunging through the air - sans safety net! Gasp when you see our throng of clowns plummet to their seeming deaths, all to make you laugh, dear paying audience! But don't worry, all of it is completely safe... for you![/i][/quote]http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/

[b]NEW portraits[/b]
Several new portraits have been added in this update. These can be unlocked with AwesomePoints:[list][*]Borble Birk
[*]Little Johny
[*]Hawk bomb
[*]Katy Kork
[*]Rob Bourgogne
[*]Don Steward[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced startup time in case of certain rather rare router settings
[*]Fixed a rare crash in replays if the chatlog was corrupted.
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth, now also affects the duration of chains.[/list]

[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Lowered the glass platform in front of the front bottom turrets to make sure all ‘Nauts can jump up into that hide area.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Toning down some of the recent changes which turned Ayla players into Evil Eye + DoT cannons, and make Rage a bit more viable again.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 7%>14%>21%>28%>35% to 10%>16%>22%>28%>34%.
[*]Jail Food, damage over time reduced from 120 to 105 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Base speed reduced by 7%.
[*]Rocket launch, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 25%.
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Mad Bomb, now increases self-knockback by 30%.
[*]Scorched cigar pouch, slow reduction from 12.5% to 10% per stage.
[*]Nuke bug, now reduces the self-knockback as well as the damage of Rocket launch by 30%.
[*]Liquid MRE, loading speed increase reduced from +50% to +30%, price reduced from 280 to 220.
[*]Liquid MRE, no longer framerate dependent.
[*]Box of Cirean Cigars, split into two stages, adding 20 damage each for 145 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Triple Cowbells of Honor (-shield decay rate) stimulates trying to keep the Protective Pose shield active, while players are better off activating it when needed and starting the cooldown when it’s not needed. This replacement better fits this playstyle and adds to the skill ceiling by giving players further control over their shield.[/i][list][*]Triple Cowbells of Honor, now reduces the cooldown of Protective Pose by 30% if the shield is cancelled manually.[/list]
[i]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook is underwhelming compared to his other options[/i][list][*]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook, Movement speed increase buffed from 20% to 25%, duration increased from 2 to 3 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Slight reduction of Dizzy’s powerful clearing during midgame.[/i]
-”Dizzy’s greatest hits”, damage increase now only affects Awesomenauts.
[i]Dizzy’s auto-attack base DPS is really weak. She’s supposed to be low-damage/low-risk, but it was a bit too much[/i][list][*]Bubble Shot, damage increased from 65 to 70.
[*]Blowfish Nozzle, static bubble duration increased from 1.5s to 2s, price increased to 175.
[*]Slimy Markers, price reduced from 155 to 125 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Since Twister Tweeters (explosion at end of Tornado) is very popular, the Tornado duration upgrade is considered very weak. This is because it postpones the Tweeters effect. If duration also allows for cancellation, it would allow players to trigger the Tweeters effect themselves. Additionally it would improve the ability against teams who have stuns to interrupt Tornado.[/i][list][*]Bio Fuel cells, now also allows for cancelling the tornado after 1.6 second into the ability.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]While The last Pieridae Transformae is reasonably popular, it is one of the weakest options in the row as it makes Genji waste his most powerful skill on droids. Since it is unique and thematic we would like to keep it in some form though.[/i][list][*]The last Pieridae Transformae, now always produces a flying droid. Also makes Cocoon kill all types of droids.[/list]
[i]Attempt to rebalance the Blessing row.[/i][list][*]Blessing, base duration reverted from 2.5s to 3s.
[*]The Cat Pillar, healing reduced to 100 per stage, price reduced to 175 per stage.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, now increases damage of affected allies by +8%.
[*]Kremzon Calendar, cooldown reduction increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds per stage.
[*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, speed-up reduced to 20%.
[*]Hidden Leaves, price reduced to 175 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Popular but on the weak side, Storm Drum could use a buff.[/i][list][*]Storm Drum, price reduced from 160 to 130 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduce price of DPS weedling items significantly, as they are outclassed by more burst-oriented and more efficient items.[/i][list][*]Corrosive spores, price reduced from 180 to 150 per stage.
[*]Flex neck, price reduced from 150 to 120 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some tweaks to improve the item balance on his base attack row[/i][list][*]Bite, damage duration reduced from 5s to 4s.
[*]Rotten teeth, damage duration decrease removed, price reduced from 225 to 195 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Adjustments to make bond a little less overbearing.[/i][list][*]Psionic Bond, maximum enemy tether length reduced by 20%.
[*]Displace, swap time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.[/list]
[i]A slight buff to an underwhelming upgrade[/i][list][*]Time Travelled diamond, damage increased from +12% to +15% per stage.
[*]Root tea, effect duration increased to 3 seconds.
[*]Overexposed nature photo, now also gives Ix 50% of the healing done to allies when bonded.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b]
[i]This upgrade is a downgrade in many cases, because of how the damage is spread.[/i][list][*]Micey and the Missile factory, base missile is no longer reduced in damage by this upgrade.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b]
[i]Surprise Party Mask (+damage out of stealth) is too expensive for what it does[/i][list][*]Surprise Party Mask, merged to one stage of +110 damage for 200 Solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Dynamite throw, collision size vs. characters increased by 15%.
[*]Missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Another missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Height per jump increased by 8%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[i]Drawing speed is hardly a problem for Rocco, so the Birdseed Donuts (reduced draw speed) upgrade is very unpopular. It also makes lob-shots harder to pull off, which are a popular way of making arrow shots harder to dodge.[/i][list][*]Birdseed Donuts, now reduces the cooldown of vengeance by 2s for hitting a precision shot, and extends vengeance by 1s if it is active.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Scoop_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]The Holy Cup has become the way to go in high level play as the benefits are huge for a close-knit team.[/i][list][*]The Holy Cup, ally healing reduced from 75% to 65% of self healing.[/list]
[i]This upgrade gives too little compared to other upgrades in the same row, also too expensive.[/i][list][*]Chain mail Tunic, attack speed increase increased from +8% to 10% per stage.[/list]
[i]A slight tweak to make this upgrade trigger a little less often[/i][list][*]Titanium Coneshield, reduced health Scoop needs to be below from 80% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Teleport Beacon, explosion radius increased by 25%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade used to be useful for unintended extra burst damage for the Teleport Beacon ability, until it received a significant arming time in a recent update. This modification should make it more viable again[/i][list][*]Circuits of Time, decoy arming time reduced from 2 to 1 second, fixed collision detection.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash 3rd punch, replaced ceiling detection hack with actual smaller collision vs. obstacles.
[*]Stolen couch, range reduced from +5 to +4, price reduced from 190 to 170 solar
[*]Small Volcano, price reduced from 225 to 205 solar.
[*]Electric hammer, snare duration reduced from 0.5s to 0.35s, price reduced from 220 to 200 solar.
[*]Bash, base damage increased by 10%
[*]Chunk of salted meat, damage reduced from +13% to +10% per stage, price reduced from 215 to 195 per stage.
[*]Pale Mead, now increases damage of third punch, +70 damage for 280 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b][list][*]Magic Sunballs, price reduced from 220 to 195 solar.
[*]Sawblade, damage is now dealt through a fast 0.1 second DoT to prevent it from stacking with Spare Blade damage.
[*]Fixed that on the minimap Totem showed a glass platform above it.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b][list][*]Fixed Pyromancer Smiles’ splash art not being large enough in the end of game screen.
[*]Fixed that flamethrower sound kept playing if Smiles started teleporting while shooting.
[*]Pocket Dog, damage over time per stage reduced from 100 to 90.
[*]Bush Fire, damage per flame reduced from 31 to 28.
[*]Tail Whip, damage reduced from 300 to 280.
[*]Tail Whip, stun duration reduced from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds.
[*]Unicornian Butt, stun duration increase reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds, price increased from 200 to 240.
[*]Trapper's Hook, duration is now affected by Baby Kuri Mammoth.
[*]Base health, reduced from 1650 to 1550.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b][list][*]Titanium spikes damage increase increased from +10% to +12% per stage.
[*]Chrono rift, cooldown reduction increased from 2 to 2.5 seconds, for 165 solar per stage.
[*]Flash forward, no longer decreases bubble duration.
[*]Giant Monocle, range increase decreased from 27% to 22%.
[*]Instant charge battery, price reduced from 210 to 150 solar per stage.
[*]Flyswatter, now adds a non-stacking DoT to laser which deals 80 damage over 4 seconds.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.
[*]Wraith Stone, replaced by Barrier Magazine.[/list]

[b]Modding new features[/b][list][*]Particles can now be modded. You can edit them in the Particle Editor and include them in your mods. To access the Particle Editor you must be in a map editing session on a map that is part of a mod. Press F2 to open it. Press “New” to create a new particle template. Modded particles can be used in levels through the Particle object.
[*]Can now override default turret health through the new setting [i]healthOverride[/i].
[*]Can now override turret shoot cooldown through the new setting [i]shootCooldownOverride[/i]. Note that turret shooting speed is limited to 10 bullets per second for stability reasons.
[*]Can now add additional damage to turret bullets through the new setting [i]additionalDamage[/i]. By setting negative numbers here you can even create healing turrets now.
[*]Can now override what bullets a turret shoots through the new setting [i]overrideBulletSettings[/i]. Note that not all bullet types actually work with turrets, but most do. (Holy cow, turrets shooting Derpl Nukes are scary!)
[*]Can now override at what distance a turrets starts aiming and shooting at characters through the new setting [i]targetingRangeOverride[/i].

notes.title: Patch notes for Update 4.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is now available! The patch notes for this update are included below, but [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1469721435682506733]we've posted a more reader-friendly summary of what's included in this update in another announcement.[/url]

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy the latest Awesomenauts update!

[h1]Update 4.4[/h1]
Released on 5-10-2017

[b]NEW: Brawls[/b]
Patch 4.4 introduces a brand new matchmaking game mode: Brawls![quote]Brawls will present limited time opportunities to play with and against other players in special matchmade bouts with unique rulesets. From regular Awesomenauts matches on weird new maps to triple damage team deathmatch with only Rocco’s, Brawl is set up to spice up and diversify your Awesomenauts experience. 

We’ve seen a lot of players enjoying many wacky and weird game modes in custom games. There’s even been some very fun to watch tournaments (King of the Frogs comes to mind). Brawl will make that experience accessible by adding matchmaking, and rewards. Brawl will be a highly accessible purefun™ gamemode. Some characters might be grossly overpowered in some of these game modes, but in brawls that’s part of the fun!

Brawls will award Awesomepoints and experience, just like regular matches. The first 3 brawl matches, though, will award 4 times as much![/quote][b]NEW: Daily  Missions[/b]
Daily missions are random objectives that will award you with Awesomepoints when you complete them. You can have up to 3 Daily Missions available to you and a brand new mission will appear each day.[quote]Daily Missions will appear in the main menu and will have various different types of objectives and reward amounts. Some missions might require you to play a random character, while others will ask you to deal a specified amount of damage to enemy turrets. You will be able to complete these objectives in both the Co-op versus Bots and Online Match game modes.

To keep overall Awesomepoints gain the same now that Daily Missions are introduced, Awesomepoints gain for matches has been reduced.[/quote]
[b]NEW: Main Menu Tiles[/b]
Main Menu Tiles are banners in the main menu that point you to various aspects of the game. The game will try to figure out what kind of information is appropriate for you and will then show a tile for it. For example, tiles will alert you when a character is close to leveling up, or advise a certain game mode.

[b]NEW: Skill aiming visuals[/b]
In order to help players see where their skills will end up, we’ve added aiming visuals for almost all of them. Some characters already had these visuals, like the Lunge for Deadlift or skills which require charging such as Lonestar’s Dynamite. Now when you hold down the action button to trigger a skill, you’ll see it’s effect visualized in the game. Letting go will then trigger the skill. Of course if you feel you don’t need it and want skills to trigger just that bit faster, you can turn it off in the settings.

Known issues:
[list][*]Penny dash distance prediction not accurate
[*]Clunk bite aim shown on wrong side of character when aiming backwards
[*]Froggy dash icon is not shown as disabled while tornado is active[/list]

[b]NEW premium skin: Soulhuntress Raelynn[/b]
[quote][i]Whoever said 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend' sure never met Soulhuntress Raelynn. Though she spends her days hunting demons, cultists, and other evil scum (which lots of folk appreciate), she's not particularly nice company at parties and friendly get-togethers. One time she attended a feast some villagers organized in her honor and she used her laser rifle to 'cleanse' the demon-shaped chocolate cake the villagers had spent days to prepare for her in secret. In the end, she's just not a people person, and most people have learned to leave her alone and not invite her to their parties.

She is GREAT friends with Cuddles though. Together they've cleansed more demons and other evildoers from this world than you'd feel comfortable knowing. And a chocolate cake.[/i][/quote]

This is a paid DLC and comes with a fully customized voice set and a portrait! http://store.steampowered.com/app/605940/Awesomenauts__Soulhuntress_Raelynn_Skin/

[b]NEW announcer: Ringmaster Announcer[/b]
[quote][i]Ladies and Gentlenauts, welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! It's a brand new show in the greatest big top of the galaxy. Step right up, step right up!

The Zork family is proud to present you tonight's entertainment: a feast of slaughter, daring adventures, and violence! We'll keep you on the edge of your seat as the intrepid heroes perform for you in our Circus. Witness the marvel of twenty Nauts plunging through the air - sans safety net! Gasp when you see our throng of clowns plummet to their seeming deaths, all to make you laugh, dear paying audience! But don't worry, all of it is completely safe... for you![/i][/quote]http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/

[b]NEW portraits[/b]
Several new portraits have been added in this update. These can be unlocked with AwesomePoints:[list][*]Borble Birk
[*]Little Johny
[*]Hawk bomb
[*]Katy Kork
[*]Rob Bourgogne
[*]Don Steward[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]Reduced startup time in case of certain rather rare router settings
[*]Fixed a rare crash in replays if the chatlog was corrupted.
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth, now also affects the duration of chains.[/list]

[b]Aiguillon[/b][list][*]Lowered the glass platform in front of the front bottom turrets to make sure all ‘Nauts can jump up into that hide area.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Toning down some of the recent changes which turned Ayla players into Evil Eye + DoT cannons, and make Rage a bit more viable again.[/i][list][*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 7%>14%>21%>28%>35% to 10%>16%>22%>28%>34%.
[*]Jail Food, damage over time reduced from 120 to 105 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Commander_Rocket_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Commander Rocket[/b][list][*]Base speed reduced by 7%.
[*]Rocket launch, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 25%.
[*]Rocket Launch, no longer knocks back enemies.
[*]Mad Bomb, now increases self-knockback by 30%.
[*]Scorched cigar pouch, slow reduction from 12.5% to 10% per stage.
[*]Nuke bug, now reduces the self-knockback as well as the damage of Rocket launch by 30%.
[*]Liquid MRE, loading speed increase reduced from +50% to +30%, price reduced from 280 to 220.
[*]Liquid MRE, no longer framerate dependent.
[*]Box of Cirean Cigars, split into two stages, adding 20 damage each for 145 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Triple Cowbells of Honor (-shield decay rate) stimulates trying to keep the Protective Pose shield active, while players are better off activating it when needed and starting the cooldown when it’s not needed. This replacement better fits this playstyle and adds to the skill ceiling by giving players further control over their shield.[/i][list][*]Triple Cowbells of Honor, now reduces the cooldown of Protective Pose by 30% if the shield is cancelled manually.[/list]
[i]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook is underwhelming compared to his other options[/i][list][*]Cowboy Boogeyman Storybook, Movement speed increase buffed from 20% to 25%, duration increased from 2 to 3 seconds.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b]
[i]Slight reduction of Dizzy’s powerful clearing during midgame.[/i]
-”Dizzy’s greatest hits”, damage increase now only affects Awesomenauts.
[i]Dizzy’s auto-attack base DPS is really weak. She’s supposed to be low-damage/low-risk, but it was a bit too much[/i][list][*]Bubble Shot, damage increased from 65 to 70.
[*]Blowfish Nozzle, static bubble duration increased from 1.5s to 2s, price increased to 175.
[*]Slimy Markers, price reduced from 155 to 125 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Since Twister Tweeters (explosion at end of Tornado) is very popular, the Tornado duration upgrade is considered very weak. This is because it postpones the Tweeters effect. If duration also allows for cancellation, it would allow players to trigger the Tweeters effect themselves. Additionally it would improve the ability against teams who have stuns to interrupt Tornado.[/i][list][*]Bio Fuel cells, now also allows for cancelling the tornado after 1.6 second into the ability.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]While The last Pieridae Transformae is reasonably popular, it is one of the weakest options in the row as it makes Genji waste his most powerful skill on droids. Since it is unique and thematic we would like to keep it in some form though.[/i][list][*]The last Pieridae Transformae, now always produces a flying droid. Also makes Cocoon kill all types of droids.[/list]
[i]Attempt to rebalance the Blessing row.[/i][list][*]Blessing, base duration reverted from 2.5s to 3s.
[*]The Cat Pillar, healing reduced to 100 per stage, price reduced to 175 per stage.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, now increases damage of affected allies by +8%.
[*]Kremzon Calendar, cooldown reduction increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds per stage.
[*]Gettin’ Out of Da Hood, speed-up reduced to 20%.
[*]Hidden Leaves, price reduced to 175 solar per stage.[/list]
[i]Popular but on the weak side, Storm Drum could use a buff.[/i][list][*]Storm Drum, price reduced from 160 to 130 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduce price of DPS weedling items significantly, as they are outclassed by more burst-oriented and more efficient items.[/i][list][*]Corrosive spores, price reduced from 180 to 150 per stage.
[*]Flex neck, price reduced from 150 to 120 per stage.[/list]
[i]Some tweaks to improve the item balance on his base attack row[/i][list][*]Bite, damage duration reduced from 5s to 4s.
[*]Rotten teeth, damage duration decrease removed, price reduced from 225 to 195 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Adjustments to make bond a little less overbearing.[/i][list][*]Psionic Bond, maximum enemy tether length reduced by 20%.
[*]Displace, swap time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.[/list]
[i]A slight buff to an underwhelming upgrade[/i][list][*]Time Travelled diamond, damage increased from +12% to +15% per stage.
[*]Root tea, effect duration increased to 3 seconds.
[*]Overexposed nature photo, now also gives Ix 50% of the healing done to allies when bonded.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b]
[i]This upgrade is a downgrade in many cases, because of how the damage is spread.[/i][list][*]Micey and the Missile factory, base missile is no longer reduced in damage by this upgrade.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b]
[i]Surprise Party Mask (+damage out of stealth) is too expensive for what it does[/i][list][*]Surprise Party Mask, merged to one stage of +110 damage for 200 Solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b][list][*]Dynamite throw, collision size vs. characters increased by 15%.
[*]Missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Another missile, projectile collision vs. obstacles reduced by 15%.
[*]Height per jump increased by 8%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[i]Drawing speed is hardly a problem for Rocco, so the Birdseed Donuts (reduced draw speed) upgrade is very unpopular. It also makes lob-shots harder to pull off, which are a popular way of making arrow shots harder to dodge.[/i][list][*]Birdseed Donuts, now reduces the cooldown of vengeance by 2s for hitting a precision shot, and extends vengeance by 1s if it is active.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Scoop_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]The Holy Cup has become the way to go in high level play as the benefits are huge for a close-knit team.[/i][list][*]The Holy Cup, ally healing reduced from 75% to 65% of self healing.[/list]
[i]This upgrade gives too little compared to other upgrades in the same row, also too expensive.[/i][list][*]Chain mail Tunic, attack speed increase increased from +8% to 10% per stage.[/list]
[i]A slight tweak to make this upgrade trigger a little less often[/i][list][*]Titanium Coneshield, reduced health Scoop needs to be below from 80% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b][list][*]Teleport Beacon, explosion radius increased by 25%.[/list]
[i]This upgrade used to be useful for unintended extra burst damage for the Teleport Beacon ability, until it received a significant arming time in a recent update. This modification should make it more viable again[/i][list][*]Circuits of Time, decoy arming time reduced from 2 to 1 second, fixed collision detection.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Bash 3rd punch, replaced ceiling detection hack with actual smaller collision vs. obstacles.
[*]Stolen couch, range reduced from +5 to +4, price reduced from 190 to 170 solar
[*]Small Volcano, price reduced from 225 to 205 solar.
[*]Electric hammer, snare duration reduced from 0.5s to 0.35s, price reduced from 220 to 200 solar.

[*]Sawblade, damage is now dealt through a fast 0.1 second DoT to prevent it from stacking with Spare Blade damage.
[*]Fixed that on the minimap Totem showed a glass platform above it.[/list]

[*]Fixed that flamethrower sound kept playing if Smiles started teleporting while shooting.
[*]Pocket Dog, damage over time per stage reduced from 100 to 90.
[*]Bush Fire, damage per flame reduced from 31 to 28.
[*]Tail Whip, damage reduced from 300 to 280.
[*]Tail Whip, stun duration reduced from 0.2 to 0.1 seconds.
[*]Unicornian Butt, stun duration increase reduced from 0.3 to 0.2 seconds, price increased from 200 to 240.

Modded particles can be used in levels through the Particle object.

[*]Can now override what bullets a turret shoots through the new setting [i]overrideBulletSettings[/i]. Note that not all bullet types actually work with turrets, but most do. (Holy cow, turrets shooting Derpl Nukes are scary!)
[*]Can now override at what distance a turrets starts aiming and shooting at characters through the new setting [i]targetingRangeOverride[/i].
[*]Can now swap the default orientation of turrets through the new setting [i]swapDefaultOrientation[/i].
[*]Can now hide turrets from the minimap through the new setting [i]showOnMiniMap[/i].
[*]Can now let Buttons turn Turrets on/off through the new setting [i]activationInfluencedBy[/i].
[*]Buttons can now turn Particle objects on/off.
[*]Tutorial textures and animations can now be used in modded maps.[/list]

[b]Modding fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed that the [i]hideByButton[/i] option in Texture objects didn’t work if anything in the Texture was animated, and didn’t combine correctly with setting a colour on the Texture.
[*]Fixed that if [i]opacity[/i] and [i]colour[/i] were both set on an Animation object, then particles inside the animation would not update their colour correctly anymore.
[*]Fixed that automatically reloading textures while editing a modded map didn’t work. (Works both in DirectX and OpenGL, but not on Linux and Mac.)
[*]Fixed that when browsing Animations or Particles they were positioned too high, half over the button above.
[*]Fixed mod preset not being selected by default when editing a map.[/list]

notes.title: Cirque du Brawlee - OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/0146e2227aa53e87c7ce262199ed02d0fcc51734.png[/img]
Step right up, step right up! Cirque du Brawlee has rolled into town!

 It’s a true festival of carnage with the addition of a weekly Brawl that provides bonus XP and Awesomepoints rewards to participants, and every weekend players will be able to enjoy a new gameplay mode with different rules, powers, and modifiers. For instance, this week we’re starting with the Unlimited Power Brawl - a game mode where all upgrades have a fixed price and there are no restrictions on how many upgrades you can have. Which ‘Naut will reign supreme when all there’s nothing to hold them back?[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e876624a01b6b62c9a5d0de91e2683328bea61e5.jpg[/img]
This latest update also introduces Daily Missions. These missions challenge players to complete matches with a specific type of character, to claim victory in a certain number of matches, or to fulfill another objective. The reward for completing these missions? Sweet, sweet Awesomepoints that players can use to purchase additional characters or unlock other cosmetic upgrades.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2f406ceee48724da80db6788a6a88efe0cd6d931.jpg[/img]
In addition to these new gameplay features, we’ve also further refined the experience for players who are new to Awesomenauts. To welcome these new players into our community, we’re providing them with new features that help them predict the effective range of their abilities, and are providing them with a set of daily missions that help them explore the various features Awesomenauts has to offer. We're sure many of these changes will also benefit veteran players who are experimenting with newer characters or returning to the community.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bb9862a1f92e9e1bdb1a83ee89b06f74e858f4bd.png[/img]
On top of all these new features, we're also adding a batch of new profile portraits to the mix, and releasing the Soulhuntress Raelynn skin, as well as the Ringmaster announcer! http://store.steampowered.com/app/399837/Awesomenauts__The_Ringmaster_Announcer/ http://store.steampowered.com/app/605940/Awesomenauts__Soulhuntress_Raelynn_Skin/ We’ve got more content lined up for the last couple of months in 2017. Qi’Tara, the character lined up to become the 33rd Awesomenaut, will be revealed in full soon. She is expected to make her public debut in an open beta within the next couple of weeks.

notes.title: Soulhuntress Raelynn is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/c9691e1dcb45206e56923fed536cd25619637cc8.png[/img]On top of all the cool features [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1500120099367633488]we've already got lined up for Awesomenauts 4.4[/url], we're adding a brand-new skin for Raelynn! Soulhuntress Raelynn is here, and she's ready to hunt down all the demons, cultists, and other evil-doers you can throw at her!

[quote]Whoever said 'The enemy of my enemy is my friend' sure never met Soulhuntress Raelynn. Though she spends her days hunting demons, cultists, and other evil scum (which lots of folk appreciate), she's not particularly nice company at parties and friendly get-togethers. One time she attended a feast some villagers organized in her honor and she used her laser rifle to 'cleanse' the demon-shaped chocolate cake the villagers had spent days to prepare for her in secret. In the end, she's just not a people person, and most people have learned to leave her alone and not invite her to their parties.

She is GREAT friends with Cuddles though. Together they've cleansed more demons and other evildoers from this world than you'd feel comfortable knowing. And a chocolate cake.
[/quote]

notes.title: Cirque du Brawlee rolls into town October 4th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f15ea2b5aca91e6e7f24379a4790333bea45b32c.png[/img]Get ready! Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee is launching on October 4th!

One week from now, we're launching a massive update with plenty of cool stuff to look forward to. Get hype for the addition of Daily Missions, the arrival of a weekly Brawl that grants you lots of bonus XP and Awesomepoints, and an overhauled menu. And that's not all! We still have some announcements lined up for the rest of the week. So stay tuned.

If you want to know more about what's currently in the Open Beta for Awesomenauts 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1476475566792985563]read up on our recent blogpost about that[/url]. If you're interested in the list of tentative balance changes that will be included in this update, you can [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=51160]catch the full patch notes of the current Beta version on our official forums[/url]. Want to know how to gain access to the Open Beta? You can learn more about that [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487]on our official forums as well[/url].
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e876624a01b6b62c9a5d0de91e2683328bea61e5.jpg[/img]We've been testing various Brawls in the Open Beta over the last week, and have been listening to your feedback on that. We're likely making some changes to some of these when the update goes live, but we'll detail those changes at a later point.

Once Awesomenauts 4.4 goes live, a new Brawl will be available every weekend. Some of the Brawls that we've been testing in the Beta so far include:[list][*]Girl Power - A regular Awesomenauts game, but only female 'Nauts are allowed![*]Unlimited Power - All upgrades cost 75 Solar and you can buy all 6 items in a row. Nothing can hold you back![*]Team Deathmatch - The Classic. Kill more 'Nauts than the enemy team.[*]Randomnauts - A regular game of Awesomenauts, but every time you die you respawn as a different character, with random upgrades.[*]Tip top - Everyone plays as Rocco. Damage is cranked up to 300%. First team to 50 Kills wins.[/list][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2f406ceee48724da80db6788a6a88efe0cd6d931.jpg[/img]Get ready for Daily Missions, and start earning bonus Awesomepoints for completing them. You can already try out Daily Missions in the Open Beta, and any points you earn there will carry over to the live version!

We've got more surprises lined up for the next few days to stay tuned. See you in Cirque du Brawlee!

notes.title: Update 4.4 Open Beta Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/f1c23cc4d9a7f28898a93eace4a0c82d6c5d8d7f.png[/img]Welcome to Cirque du Brawlee! Awesomenauts 4.4 brings a massive batch of cool new features, and the Open Beta is available to all players right now for to try them out.

On the Streamisho today, we unveiled the biggest feature coming in Update 4.4: Weekly Brawls! Every week we'll have a new event for you to play, and during the Open Beta we'll be testing a whole bunch of them. Once Update 4.4: Cirque du Brawlee launches, these Weekly Brawls will be live from every Thursday until late Sunday... and you're getting a new Brawl every weekend.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e876624a01b6b62c9a5d0de91e2683328bea61e5.jpg[/img]
To kick things off, the Beta currently has the Girl Power Brawl active. This boils down to a regular match of 'Nauts, but you only have access to female 'Nauts. That means your selection is limited to Coco, Raelynn, Penny, Nibbs, Dizzy, Ayla, and Ksenia!

The Brawl available in the Beta will change in a few days, allowing you to try out some of the other Brawls we've got lined up for you. We'll keep them a surprise for now... but how does an All-Rocco Deathmatch sound, for starters?

On top of these Brawls, the Open Beta also includes the features we revealed last week. Try out some of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/2888353506904449965]new Daily Missions and the new Livetiles in the main menu[/url], and give us your feedback on the extensive balance changes that are included in this update.[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2f406ceee48724da80db6788a6a88efe0cd6d931.jpg[/img]
To access the Open Beta, all you have to do is follow these steps:

[olist][*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your library and select "Properties"
[*]In the DLC tab, make sure the "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load PC" is checked. If you're playing or Mac or Linux, tab the DLC for that OS instead.
[*]Head to the "Beta" tab and switch to "beta - public channel".
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY".[/olist]
If you want to discuss these balance tweaks or want to share your thoughts on other features in the Beta, please head over to [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]the Official Awesomenauts forum[/url]. While we try to gather feedback from all our different channels, it's easier for us to keep track of the different opinions and arguments [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19]if the discussions are centralized[/url]![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3423c5916f19095905eb42cb4ceb2af06d98f3e3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Daily missions coming in Update 4.4!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/327d7a74c15752071322017a38b217a8e908e51f.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.4 is right around the corner! This action-packed update will go into Beta next week, on September 20th, and we've already revealed the first couple of features that are included on the Streamisho!
[list][*][b]Daily Missions[/b] - Starting in Update 4.4, you'll receive a new mission every day. These missions challenge you to play or win a certain number of games, play certain game modes, try out different characters from a specific roster, and more. Completing a mission will earn you a sweet Awesomepoint bonus. For new players, these missions will be aimed at helping them understand and explore what Awesomenauts has to offer, while more experienced players will receive missions that focus on winning matches![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/116275d0e47dfcdcfa8de596d96fd54e8c3928cf.png[/img]
[*][b]Overhauled main menu[/b] - We're giving the main menu a new lick of paint! Once you log in after Awesomenauts 4.4 has gone live, you'll notice that the main menu not only lists your currently active missions, but a bunch of additional tiles also highlight your recent accomplishments, milestones you're close to completing, and various other aspects of the game worth highlighting![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/bad65530fc20987f6c31eef37dad346d3b6c107a.png[/img]
[*][b]New modding features![/b] - The modding community continues to create awesome new mods (like [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1131788785]this awesome Ghostbusters mod by EgyptFalcon[/url]) and we want to provide them with the tools to make their mods even better! In Update 4.4, we're adding the ability to add custom particles to your mods, as well as change turret settings. Want to create a turret that shoots Derpl nukes? Now you can! Want to create a cool mod where a turret shoots at players to heal them? Say no more! We've got you covered![/list]

Interested in how all of this looks in practice? Catch the VOD for the Streamisho! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G4DQSMoPIGc And that's not all! The biggest feature we're adding in the update is still a secret! Come back next week to learn all about the update and try it out in the Open Beta for yourself![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/83112268dd181c322a847536fbabbed7fa9b3b2b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: A new Season has started!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d1b62bea1138e27d87d816437ee49fbfc3acd242.jpg[/img]
A new season has started! Enjoy!

This means everyone gets a fresh start at climbing the leaderboards. Since a new season is essentially a leaderboard reset it also means that the matchmaker won't know player skills for a while, so expect matchups to be all over the place for a few days.

Everyone has been reset to the default ranking of 10,000. Note that new players will still have a lower rating because anyone with less than 100 matches automatically gets reduced rating. So new players won't notice the reset as much as more experienced players.

This reset only influences your leaderboard rating. You'll keep any character and account progress you've made.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.3 - NOW LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/ed726d9507147645cda62dcb68f3b4c99991d482.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.3: Ready to Rock it! is now live on Steam, so log in and try out the latest Awesomenaut to join the cast: Commander Rocket!

What this character lacks in burst damage and size, he more than makes up in the ability to relentlessly harass his opponents in a lane. His auto attack stores up several missiles over time that you all fire at once, allowing Rocket to deal tremendous damage when harassing enemies in a lane with hit & run tactics. His first ability, Rocket Launcher, fires off a huge rocket that travels a fair distance and deals significant damage, while also knocking away enemies. Rocket himself will also be launched backwards by recoil, which experienced players will be able to use to deftly move themselves around the map with!

His final ability, Laser Trap, launches a small device that (after a little charge-up time) starts spinning around and blast enemies within range with lasers. It deals a lot of damage to enemies unable to escape, and is therefore especially powerful when deployed in chokepoints on the map or when teammates help CC enemies!

Want to know more? SlowWolf has released a great character showcase video that covers everything you need to know! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kW--cFM8vHw
Commander Rocket is now available to every player who owns the All Nauts Pack and can be unlocked with Awesomepoints in-game for everyone else! If you don't have enough Awesomepoints available you can purchase the new character directly from the store. http://store.steampowered.com/app/561567
Commander Rocket launches alongside an awesome Commander Cook-It skin that transforms the grizzled veteran into a chef loaded to the brim with food-puns and vegetables in his launcher! Check him out in-game! http://store.steampowered.com/app/634012
We've got more awesome stuff [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1451701826004633393]lined up for you throughout the month[/url], and you'll want to return tomorrow to redeem a free Digital G skin (which you get just for logging in) and start enjoying a quadruple XP and Awesomepoint bonus for your first win of the day! This all ties in to [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1451701826004633393]the events we've got lined up to celebrate the five year Anniversary of Awesomenauts on Steam[/url], and we hope you'll join us!

If you're visiting Gamescom next week, make sure to drop by our booth in Hall 10.1 - booth A41, and play some games with us, say hi, and win cool prizes!

notes.title: New Weekly Rotation has started!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/34a4c2eff196483a5909169866861e4fe27c8dce.jpg[/img]It's Monday, so a brand new weekly rotation has started! Try out Gnaw, Coco Nebulon, Skree, and Admiral Swiggins for free all week!

Dominate the battlefield with Weedlings and poison your enemies as Gnaw, or use Lightning Ball to ambush and push around your opponents with Coco. Admiral Swiggins, a character designed by the community in the original Design A Naut contest, allows you to lunge at opponents with your anchor and them lock them down. Doing so means you temporarily trade your powerful melee attack for a tricky ranged attack though, so make sure to adjust your playstyle accordingly after initiating. 

Finally, rounding out the weekly roster is Skree - a technoshaman that made his home on the Starstorm Station. His chain lightning is especially dangerous against bunched-up enemies, and his sawblades give him a powerful zoning ability. His second ability, which summons a totem, doesn't deal any damage but allows Skree to block off escapes or lines of fire... so don't underestimate it!

The weekly rotation is available to all players with account level 6 or higher!
