notes.title: Celebrating Five Years on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e1d450f69e07c17946d5e6546ad59114d8e34a04.png[/img]Hey everyone! Today marks the [b]fifth anniversary[/b] of Awesomenauts on Steam! A lot has happened since we launched back in 2012, but we'd like that thank all of you for your support, feedback, and inspiration since then!

We'll be celebrating this milestone throughout August, with [b]great bonus events[/b] in several weekends, the [b]launch of Commander Rocket[/b], [b]raffles[/b] on our social channels, as well as a bunch of [b]giveaways[/b] and [b]additional surprises[/b]! We'll also be at Gamescom in Cologne from August 22nd until August 26th with our biggest booth ever, so make sure to high-five us at booth A41 in Hall 10.1 if you're attending!

There's lots of cool stuff to look forward to, and we'll detail that with a full schedule soon. For now, you can look forward to a special Streamisho tomorrow (Wednesday August 2nd, twitch.tv/RonimoGames, 17:00 EU Time) as well as the first Weekend Event starting this Thursday (August 3rd).

Over the last five years Awesomenauts has grown from a small indie MOBA to a free-to-play title with an incredible community! We couldn't have done that without your support, so thank [b]YOU[/b] for being part of the Awesomenauts!

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2.1 - Hotfix live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.png[/img]
We just released Awesomenauts 4.2.1, a hotfix for the recently-released 4.2 update! This update adresses some bugs related character skills, upgrades, and other issues!

Thanks to everyone who reported issues and provided feedback on the recent changes. Please continue to let us know what you think of Smiles  Catch the patch notes below:

[h1][b]Update 4.2.1 hotfix[/b][/h1]

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]Using a controller no longer results in selecting five different buttons in the dropdown from the main menu screen. 
[*]Fixed that you couldn’t select the announcer dropdown in the in-game pause screen with a controller.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that 3rd punch was unable to damage structures.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Smiles_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Smiles[/b]
[i]Released in a slightly too powerful state, some changes to tone down his problematic Trapper’s Hook skill[/i][list]
[*]Fixed the levelling unlock order for Piggybank and Barrier magazine upgrades.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, range reduced by 20%.
[*]Hook, reel in time increased from 0.7s to 2s, now scales with Bush Telly.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, projectile speed reduced by 20%.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, minimum rope length increased by 25%.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, will no longer pull a Nibbs performing fire breath.
[*]-Electric Magnetic Winch upgrade, range increase reduced from 25% to 20%.
[*]-Sandworm Tail upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 50% to 40%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that Stormdrum would always show a healing effect, even without buying Caterpillar King statue.
[*]Fixed that the butterfly shot would not return after buying the Wool Shawl and Glow Bracelets upgrades.
[*]Fixed that the cocoon would immediately kill an enemy droid when The last pieridae transformae upgrade was bought[/list]

Don't have the All Nauts pack yet? No worries! You can also unlock him with Awesomepoints if you've been saving up!

The latest update is the second one we're releasing this summer and there's a lot more coming up! Stay tuned for more news about awesome content launching beyond Update 4.2!

In addition to Smiles joining the Awesomenauts, we're also releasing a pretty awesome skin for him. Check out Pyromancer Smiles! http://store.steampowered.com/app/497621
Catch the full patch notes below!

[h1][b]Update 4.2[/b][/h1]
12-7-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
[list][*]Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
[*]Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel stail, knocking them away.
[*]Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.[/list]

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]NEW skin: Pyromancer Smiles[/b]
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He has peered into the flames and had visions of him setting all of creation ablaze! He's left the (now scorched) swamps of Ribbit II on a quest to fulfill this dark destiny, and stowed away on the Awesomenauts vessel to visit distant worlds. What's left standing after a battle is incinerated by the Pyromancer, until only ash remains.

He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp! The Flames command it!

[b]NEW: added portraits[/b][list][*]Fire commander
[*]Ice commander
[*]Love commander
[*]Team power
[*]The collection
[*]Hairy King[/list]

[b]General[/b][list][*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes after closing the Steam overlay and pressing enter to chat, it would register as a shift+enter instead, opening all chat instead of team chat.
[*]Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
[*]There is a new, more streamlined tutorial flow for new players.
[*]Fixed that running on 1280x1024 or using the Screen Adjustment feature would cut off parts of the in-game HUD.
[*]Steam IDs are no longer logged while in character select, fixing that players could figure out who they were going to play against before the match actually started.
[*]Fixed that practice games could be joined via chat, for a short period.
[*]Fixed that banned players wouldn’t get a ‘cancelled’ notification when trying to queue[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b][list][*]Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
[*]Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.[/list]

[b]Menus[/b][list][*]Fixed that League 1 didn't exist for some older seasons in the leaderboad history.
[*]Depth issue fix for character icons in menus on Mac.
[*]Fixed that it was possible to get stuck in a state where all buttons in the Play menu are locked after trying to join a custom game of which the last slot was just taken by another player.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking multiple times on a character profile picture in a lobby would result in an endless growing tooltip.
[*]The tooltip about the items that you can buy now correctly states level 3 instead of level 4 at which you have unlocked all items.[/list]

[b]Sound[/b][list][*]Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.
[*]The “test voice” button in the Armory now correctly plays voice lines of premium skins.
[*]Announcer voices and player-triggered character voices are now better audible.[/list]

[b]Bots[/b][list][*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots[/list]

[b]Modding[/b][list][*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.
[*]Added an option to Button to only react to a specific character class.
[*]Added automatic backup to the map editor (once every two minutes and when exiting the editing session).
[*]Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list][*]Explosive Clone, arming time reduced from 1s to 0.9s.
[*]Torn D-Shirt upgrade, now only affects Awesomenauts.
[*]Golden G Necklace upgrade, after arming the Explosive Clone it stays in place for 1s until an enemy touches it.
[*]Removed a voiceline in which Dizzy said Froggy is her nephew, while he is her cousin.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b]
[i]Changes to make Frog a bit more safe while also reducing all or nothing potency with landing his whirlwind.[/i][list][*]Base health increased from 1150 to 1200.
[*]Dash, base damage increased from 250 to 280.
[*]Ice Cubes upgrade, slow per stage reduced from 15% to 12%, price reduced from 150 to 140.
[*]Clock Necklace upgrade, heal over time reduced from 140 to 120.
[*]Boombox upgrade, damage increase reduced from 16% to 13% per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list][*]Baby Kuri Mammoth now affects cocoon.
[*]Butterfly shot, fixed that returning projectile now also does 65 at base.
[*]Wool Shawl upgrade, range increase reduced from 40% to 30%.[/list]
[i]Slightly reduce the AA heal, but make stack with Praying Beads, Stormdrum and Space Hippo[/i][list][*]Caterpillar King statue upgrade, now adds ally heal to all Butterfly Shot damage output, 20% per stage.
[*]The Cat Pillar upgrade, heal amount reduced from 125 to 115 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list][*]Feather Ball upgrade, now adds a 3rd spit projectile.
[*]Fertilizer upgrade, now increases Weedling health by 20% and health regeneration by 50%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b][list][*]Salt Miner upgrade, damage per tick reduced from 18 to 16 per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list][*]Micey the Mech Pilot upgrade, price increased from 125 to 150 solar.
[*]Micey and the Missile Factory upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 200 solar.
[*]Flip Arm Add-on, damage reduced from 13% to 11% per stage.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b][list][*]Steel False Teeth upgrade, now gives Leon a shield that reduces 20% of incoming damage for 2 seconds when successfully landing tongue.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list][*]Galactic Police Scanner upgrade, damage increase reduced from 30% to 27%, price increased from 155 to 180.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled! upgrade, fixed the issue where the last bullet would sometimes not spawn.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled! upgrade, damage decreased from 150 to 120.
[*]Hairy King upgrade, size increased reduced from +15% to +10%[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list][*]Eternal Flame upgrade, fixed issue that Starstorm Statue had no effect upon the fireballs.
[*]Red Sneakers upgrade, price reduced from 155 to 140, speed increase increased from 5% to 8%.
[*]Sunscreen Mouthwash upgrade, speed increase reduced from 100% to 75%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Sentient Rock upgrade, silence duration reduced from 0.3s to 0.25s per charge.
[*]Chicken in a Lunch Box upgrade, amplified damage increase reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list][*]Base attack, speed penalty for shooting reduced by 25%.[/list]
	
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b][list][*]Vengeance, cooldown reduced from 20 to 16 seconds.
[*]Cockfight Spurs upgrade, price reduced from 200 to 180 solar per stage.
[*]Chicken Grill upgrade, price reduced from 185 to 175 solar.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]

[*]Night Vision Spywatch upgrade, movement speed increase reduced from 50% to 30%.

[*]Circuits of time upgrade, damage increased from 125 to 150.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b][list][*]Homeless Gnome upgrade, fixed an issue where the Gnome would just dissipate if thrown too far.[/list]

[*]Yakoiza upgrade, extra damage reduced from 71% to 62%.[/list]

[*]Falling, allow Yuri to keep falling through glass platforms when Jetpack is off, by pressing down.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! Launches July 12th!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9f8c73f6f85e9820436ef89fd97b79e31d138a5d.png[/img]If you didn't catch the Streamisho yesterday, you might have missed the news that Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! will launch on July 12th! Rejoice!

The new update will contain Smiles, the flamethrower-wielding Renegade, an awesome Pyromancer Smiles skin, and some sweet new portraits! If you want to catch all the details, you can rewatch the full Streamisho on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82GSJHJUXqI[h1]PYROMANCER SMILES[/h1]
Some crocodiles just want to watch the world burn. Pyromancer Smiles won't settle for that. He won't stop until all of creation is set ablaze! He's dark, he's angry, and he's armed with a flamethrower. Don't cross Pyromancer Smiles as he'll burn you to a crisp!

The Pyromancer Smiles skin will come with unique voicelines and gives an ever darker twist to the angriest Renegade of the bunch! The skin will be available when Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! launches next week![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9c2721c13ced869516060b3f49952437ff50f5f3.png[/img]
[H1]NEW MEDALS[/H1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3ff09e93e7bde68020a330f9b0292835e7d9dc84.jpg[/img]
With so many community events recently, we're adding in-game medals for accomplishments in these events in Update 4.2! How you earn them is up to the tournament hosts (with some limitations), so keep your eyes peeled for new community events in the coming weeks to learn more about how to earn these!

Are you hosting an event and want to give these away to particants? Get in touch with us through robin@ronimo-games.com!
[H1]NEW PROFILE PORTRAITS[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d7da457e6727ae6c5a7f8e32770f224733a4ee1f.jpg[/img]
We're also adding a couple of sweet new portraits to the game with this update. We'll be revealing them in the week ahead, but you can already get a sneak peak at a new Giga Sentorii portrait above!
[H1]ROOKIE ROYALE[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/aac2548bc6aed718be1560c8f0eaf1ccd373094d.png[/img]
The Rookie Royale came to a close last weekend, and it's been a great event overall. Thanks to all players who participated, were involved in coaching new players, made the event happen, and helped out with the on the shows! You guys are the best!

The Rookie Royale was an accessible tournament for players with little to no experience in the competitive community, where experienced players could coach them. We've seen a lot of new players compete, as well as many familiar faces from the community, and it's a blast overall!

Specifically, thanks to Alexeus, Slevens, Erabosu, Devmon, Uberransy, Body_Hunter, Skner, Pixelhat, Pasha, all the coaches, and everyone else who helped out behind the scenes!

Stay tuned for more events from the Awesomenauts League Project in the coming weeks.
[H1]KING OF THE FROGS[/H1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/9a6549e4fd4bcad0cd26a8cdba333249ddc8eadf.jpg[/img]
Bets hosted a drop-in/drop-out King of the Frogs event right after the Streamisho, as a follow-up to the previous round of KotF two weeks back. Rather than go head-to-head as Froggy G, players faced off as Dizzy this week.

[H1]ART CONTEST BY REXIC[/h1]
Community member Rexic hosted an art contest on the forums this week, challenging community artists to make summer-themed artwork based on Awesomenauts, with cash money as the prize! Thanks to Rexic for hosting this, because the submissions are AWESOME!

Lowgrasswhite won with an adorable piece of artwork featuring Coco and Nibbs, and it's just fantastic. Catch it below![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/415113fa5059cc4ac53cb43295e3026ee86df615.png[/img]
If you want to check out all submissions, head over to the official Awesomenauts forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=12&t=50518

notes.title: 4.2 Beta update, Smiles theme, and community news!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/3c2c9758991f3d6ec1e8cf61cb72c3a729f157fa.jpg[/img]The second update for the Open Beta of Awesomenauts 4.2 went live yesterday, and there was a lot to discuss about the changes on the Streamisho. We’ll run you through all the news below but if you prefer, you can watch it on Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2OsUyiLLGSM
[h1]Summer sale[/h1] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/182113/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/954656892a380d89c67f2eba32c4bb64c90e0c79.png[/img][/url]
The Summer Sale has arrived! This year, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/182113/]the All Nauts Pack Summer Bundle is available on Steam[/url]. It contains the All Nauts Pack and all the three costume party DLCs. There are also discounts for skins, announcers, and costume parties. Be sure to check it out in the Armory!

[h1]4.2 Beta news[/h1]
New changes were made to Awesomenauts and there were fixes for the level editor. Some balance changes are not final and might be reverted. The patch notes can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/2533687504397152680
[h1]Smiles theme[/h1]
Smiles, the newest addition to the Awesomenauts could be played in the Beta and his character theme had been unveiled in the Streamisho. Missed it? Listen to it on Youtube here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WIqpTWyJw-k&t=0s
[h1]Rookie Royale[/h1]
The third qualifier of the Rookie Royale starts on the 1st of July. It’s an accessible tournament for new players. Sign-ups are still open until the 30th of June! More info here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=50264

[h1]ALWB: King of the Frog[/h1]
The King of the Frog is a casual drop-in/drop-out tournament that’s held over a longer time span. It is a custom 1v1 tournament with either Froggy G or Dizzy. Last week, it was possible to show your Froggy G skills and Dizzy battles can be fought out next week! Check out their discord more info: ALWB.ca/discord 

[h1]Community highlight[/h1]
Are you up for a challenge with Nibbs? This custom map is designed to parkour around certain areas and complete the challenge!
Check out the Magic Dragon (Nibbs Parkour) by EgyptFalcon on the Steam workshop: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=948499054

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2 - Fired Up! Open Beta Updated
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/b910166728c576bfba14aedc7c40507957bbed74.png[/img]We just updated the Open Beta for Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired Up! on Steam! Jump into the open beta to try out a whole bunch of tweaks to the new character, Smiles, as well as further experimental changes to Derpl, Yuri, and Ted McPain!

Full patch notes are below![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png[/img]
As always, please be aware that all changes in this open beta are subject to change, and your feedback plays an important role in helping to decide what makes it into the game and what needs further tuning.

Specifically the changes to Yuri, Derpl, and Ted McPain are currently subject to change and will likely return for further tweaks in betas for later updates.

For info on how to access the open beta, [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=19&t=22487&p=274059#p274059]please visit our official forums[/url].

[h1][b]Update 4.2 Beta 2[/b][/h1]
28-6-2017

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]Fixed that (some) counters for achievements would not update for some players.
[*]Fixed that the Slowwolf announcer would not be granted to a player that got the “Welcome back!” achievement in a beta.
[*]Fixed that the “Dinosaurs don’t like brain boxes” achievement would be granted if a player makes a kill after rejoining.
[*]Made the sound ducking on announcer voices and player-triggered character voices more subtle.
[*]Fixed that if you moved the mouse very close to the centre of Coco and used her AA, her arms would extend in a different direction than her attack.
[*]Optimised all sounds to use less space on disk and in memory and to load a bit quicker.[/list]

[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added an option to Button objects to only react to a specific character class.
[*]Added an option to the AIDebugger (the F4 editor) to view detailed events about character gameplay. There is also an option to filter these events and to show them only for the selected character.
[*]Fixed a crash when using the WriteToTextbox AI block in combination with zero respawn time or switchClass/switchTeam.
[*]Fixed that actions and conditions weren’t sorted alphabetically in the BehaviourCreator tool.
[*]Fixed that AffectAreas, JumpPads and Shops didn’t become invisible in the editor when the “Gameplay objects” group was hidden.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b][list]
[*]Rip-Apart Bear upgrade, self damage reduction increased from 18% to 25%.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.[/list]

[*]Bush Fire, damage against droids increased from 21 to 25 per flame.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, duration increased from 0.8s to 1.1s.
[*]Trapper’s Hook, reeling in now takes 0.5s instead of 0.1s.

[*]Inscribed Lighter upgrade, lifetime of flames increased from 1.3s to 2s, time between damage reduced to 0.4s.
[*]Renegade walky talky upgrade, now shortens teleport to 1.5s when allies are near.[/list]

The idea is for us to iterate upon these ideas until they might one day make it into the game.[/i]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Did some tweaks since last beta, trying to make tapping the trap button stick closer to the original behaviour. The trap now only flies out when fully charged[/i][list]
[*]Grid Trap, if the skill isn’t fully charged, the Trap will be place at Derpl’s position.
[*]Grid Trap, reduced the distance covered by fully charged Trap by 50%.

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]

[*]Shotgun attack speed decreased from last beta by 20%.
[*]Shotgun damage reduced by 20%.[/list]

[*]Ammo weekly attack speed increase replaced with a damage boost of 12% per stage.
[*]Ted McPain Unicorn Dance Karting upgrade, damage per stage increased from 47 to 67.
[*]Ted’s Power Briefs upgrade, shotgun knockback increase increased from 240% to 340%.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[i]Iterating upon the ideas from the last beta, trying to remove old restrictions to make Yuri play a bit smoother while making it possible for veterans to keep their style. Additionally trying to add more depth through the charges mechanic of his laser.[/i][list]
[*]Flight, initial jump increased by 30%.
[*]Falling, allow Yuri to keep falling through glass platforms when Jetpack is off, by pressing down.
[*]Ground acceleration and speed increased by 30%.
[*]Laser, time between damage stages reduced from 1.2 to 0.7 seconds.
[*]Laser, 3rd stage added to base, each stage adds 8 damage per tick.
[*]Mine deploying, now limited to 2 mines. Creating a 3rd make the oldest explode.
[*]Mine deploying, lifetime increased from 8 to 12 seconds.
[*]Mine deploying, a hit indicator lets the Yuri player know if someone was hit by a mine.
[*]Giant Monocle upgrade, range increase now starts at 10%, every damage stage adds 10%.
[*]Resonance Amplifier upgrade, now adds 1 charge level, adding 8 damage.
[*]Hubble’s Lens upgrade, now locks Yuri in place while firing and reduces time between charges from 0.7s to 0.3s.[/list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! - Out in Beta now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7faad9f9b8b87da0bc007c8da7db8716b697ea84.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! is now live in the Open Beta for Awesomenauts! This update contains a lot of character updates, a new feature for the level editor, and a brand new playable character!
 
Meet Smiles, a crocodile with his trapping hook and a tail to run away from! Are you ready for something extra crispy? Then you definitely want to try out his flamethrower![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png[/img]To access the Beta for Update 4.2: Fired up! follow the steps below: [list]
[*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta access DLC" is checked.
[*]Select the "Beta" tab and switch to "beta - public channel".
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]This update also contains balance updates for several characters. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.2.
 
Please share your feedback on the Beta forum here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1]Update 4.2 Beta 1[/h1]
21-6-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel tail, knocking them away.
Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes when you had the steam overlay open and pressing enter, it would register as a shift+enter instead.[/list]
 
[b]Bots[/b][list]
[*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots.[/list]
 
[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Make it harder for Ayla to endlessly chase a single enemy in Rage mode, while keeping her teamfighting ability about the same.[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>20%>25%>30% to 9%>18%>27%>36%
[*]Rage, self damage increased from 33 to 40.
[*]Base Health, increased from 1350 to 1400.[/list]
[i]Boost Ayla’s earlygame, and reduce her reliance on Angry Drawings[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base DPS increased from 252 to 276.
[*]Angry Drawings upgrade, damage increase reduced from 17% to 11%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Chucho_Krokk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Chucho Krokk[/b][list]
[*]One Armed Chameleon upgrade, bonus damage reduced from 90 to 85.
[*]Nitro Muffler upgrade, damage over time reduced from 180 to 170 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b][list]
[*]Iron Slam, the hud icon now indicates which punch will be next.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Dizzy_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Dizzy[/b][list]
[*]Torn D-Shirt upgrade, now only affects Awesomenauts.
[*]Golden G Necklace upgrade, targets hit by Explosive Clone take 15% increased damage for 3 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Froggy_G_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Froggy G[/b][list]
[i]Changes to make Frog a bit more safe while also reducing all or nothing potency with landing his whirlwind.[/i]
[*]Base health increased from 1150 to 1200.
[*]Dash, base damage increased from 250 to 280.
[*]Ice Cubes upgrade, slow per stage reduced from 15% to 12%, price reduced from 150 to 140.
[*]Clock Necklace upgrade, heal over time reduced from 140 to 120.
[*]Boombox upgrade, damage increase reduced from 16% to 13% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b][list]
[*]Baby Kuri Mammoth now affects cocoon.
[*]Butterfly shot, fixed that returning projectile now also does 65 at base.
[*]Wool Shawl upgrade, range increase reduced from 40% to 30%.
[*]Caterpillar King statue upgrade, heal reduced from 20 to 18.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b][list]
[*]Feather Ball upgrade, now adds a 3rd spit projectile.
[*]Fertilizer upgrade, now increases Weedling health by 20% and health regeneration by 50%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix the Interloper[/b][list]
[*]Salt Miner upgrade, damage per tick reduced from 18 to 16 per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX5000[/b][list]
[*]Micey the Mech Pilot upgrade, price increased from 125 to 150 solar.
[*]Micey and the Missile Factory upgrade, price reduced from 215 to 200 solar.
[*]Flip Arm Add-on, damage reduced from 13% to 11% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Leon_Chameleon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Leon[/b][list]
[*]Steel False Teeth upgrade, now gives Leon a shield that reduces 20% of incoming damage for 2 seconds when successfully landing tongue.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b][list]
[*]Galactic Police Scanner upgrade, damage increase reduced from 30% to 27%, price increased from 155 to 180.
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled! Upgrade, damage decreased from 150 to 120.
[*]Hairy King upgrade, size increased reduced from +15% to +10%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b][list]
[*]Red Sneakers upgrade, price reduced from 155 to 140, speed increase increased from 5% to 8%.
[*]Sunscreen Mouthwash upgrade, speed increase reduced from 100% to 75%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list]
[*]Sentient Rock upgrade, silence duration reduced from 0.3s to 0.25s per charge.
[*]Chicken in a Lunch Box upgrade, amplified damage increase reduced from 15% to 12%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b][list]
[*]Base attack, speed penalty for shooting reduced by 25%.[/list]
    
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b][list]

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! - Out in Beta now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/7faad9f9b8b87da0bc007c8da7db8716b697ea84.png[/img]Awesomenauts 4.2: Fired up! is now live in the Open Beta for Awesomenauts! This update contains a lot of character updates, a new feature for the level editor, and a brand new playable character!
 
Meet Smiles, a crocodile with his trapping hook and a tail to run away from! Are you ready for something extra crispy? Then you definitely want to try out his flamethrower![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/40bae42027a5c5ec0b961aa7174f3a7fcc2ad1bf.png[/img]To access the Beta for Update 4.2: Fired up! follow the steps below: [list]
[*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta access DLC" is checked.
[*]Select the "Beta" tab and switch to "beta - public channel".
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]This update also contains balance updates for several characters. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.2.
 
Please share your feedback on the Beta forum here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1]Update 4.2 Beta 1[/h1]
21-6-2017

[b]NEW Naut: Smiles[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i]
Trappers Hook: Throw out a hook that will drag enemy Awesomenauts towards you for a short duration.
Tail Whip: Smack your enemies with your steel tail, knocking them away.
Bush Fire: Use your flamethrower to burn everyone in a line.

[i]Short backstory:[/i]
After he and the other renegades escaped from prison, Smiles hid in the swamps on Ribbit II. With a background of tracking and capturing targets, he put his skills to good use. The unorthodox method of poaching swamp rodents with his flame thrower, resulted in heavily burned pelts and hides, but it turned out a great business success as the dark charred bags were an instant hit on the amphibian black market. One day an old friend knocked on his door with a plan of vengeance. Step 1: join the Awesomenauts!

[b]General[/b][list]
[*]The scoreboard now tracks damage done to the base together with the damage done to turrets.
[*]Opening the shop while having the scoreboard open will now open the shop and close the scoreboard, just as it was before 4.0.
[*]Fixed that sometimes when you had the steam overlay open and pressing enter, it would register as a shift+enter instead.[/list]
 
[b]Bots[/b][list]
[*]Updated Veanko’s Leon, Lonestar, Raelynn, Gnaw, Skree, Clunk and Ayla bots.[/list]
 
[b]Modding[/b][list]
[*]Added a new option to AffectAreas to change a player’s team. This can for example be used to make mods where six players are in a single team or where you need to switch team during the mod. It is also possible to play local versus this way if only one of the local players switches team. This is an experimental feature that probably has a lot of issues, use at your own risk. For example, the deathtimers are disabled once this is used and switching to a team that doesn’t have graphics for the current class produces broken graphics (like a neutral team Lonestar). This feature might even be removed in the final release of 4.2 if we deem it too risky for final release.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Make it harder for Ayla to endlessly chase a single enemy in Rage mode, while keeping her teamfighting ability about the same.[/i][list]
[*]Rage, base shielding values changed from 15%>20%>25%>30% to 9%>18%>27%>36%

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.1 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d80afb2ae94c4bf169912230d17dc62231f8cc86.png[/img]
While everyone at E3 is focused on games shipping later this year or even in 2018, we're bringing you great new content TODAY! Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades is available on Steam now! The best part is: everyone can enjoy Awesomenauts completely for free! This patch introduces a new character, brings additional gameplay improvements, adds additional level editor functionality, and much more!
 
Rocket’s Renegades are a group of mercenaries on the run from injustice, but they’re out for revenge! Dizzy is the first of them to join the Awesomenauts in this update. Commander Rocket, Smiles, and Qi’Tara will be joining in updates later this summer! Here is the trailer introducing all four of the Renegades: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw  
Dizzy is a swift character that has the ability to dash multiple times. She can also leave a water-clone that explodes and hits all foes in the vicinity! Dizzy can be bought with Awesomepoints or will be available instantly for All Nauts Pack-owners.
 
[h1]Two new skins![/h1]

[h1]Bullbarian Deadlift[/h1]
The long awaited skin for this Bovinion is now here! Meet the brutal Bullbarian Deadlift! Show off your greatsword when playing on the red team and an astonishing axe when playing on the blue team!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/2aa7bc0c429e3ed53cab349924fc10ad11e3d990.png[/img]http://store.steampowered.com/app/557003[h1]Kunoichi Dizzy[/h1]
After three gruelling years in the Waxxon Spiral, Dizzy completed her Aqua-Fu training. She had become Kunoichi Dizzy, Master of the Aqua-Fu!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/fec69d8061496b194d557f3f8db3233e318a554f.png[/img]http://store.steampowered.com/app/634010/Awesomenauts__Kunoichi_Dizzy_Skin/
[h1]Switching classes[/h1]
Mod creators are now able to use mechanics that switch you to other‘Nauts and skins in custom maps. It is even possible to play as a creep or droid, if you want! This gives new options for creative game modes, and we can’t wait to see what crazy stuff our community members will make! Check out this small video about the feature. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xigvHbNIy7M
[h1]New medals[/h1]
We’re also adding a new series of in-game medals for players who manage to attain over 250 wins with a character! These are meant to show off the accomplishments of some our most dedicated players, who have been part of our community for years.
 
[h1]Looking ahead[/h1]
Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades is just the first update that we’ve got lined up for the summer, and players can look forward to more characters, more unlockables, and more improvements over the coming months! In fact, the next character to join the Awesomenauts will be made available in Open Beta next week already!
 
Get ready to take Smiles to the battlefield soon!
 
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
For the full patch notes on Awesomenauts 4.1, head over to our official forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=2440

notes.title: Awesomenauts is the other MOBA for people who hate MOBAs
notes.notes:
I like Heroes of the Storm because it's a MOBA you don't have to spend weeks of your life learning, but even it can sometimes be demanding. Coming back after a while away there's definitely a sense of having to regain momentum, putting in effort to catch up with the new maps and characters and the tweaks to the old ones.

Returning to Awesomenauts now that it's gone free-to-play has been a smoother experience. Originally released in 2012 by Dutch studio Ronimo, it takes some of the concepts familiar from DOTA and games like it—teams of heroes with powers on cooldown, enemy cores protected by waves of weak NPCs and hardy defences, currency to spend on improving abilities mid-match—and then slaps them onto a side-scrolling platformer with all the color and energy of a 1980s cartoon.

That changes everything. Instead of clicking to move you have direct control of your hero, and can comfortably play with a controller (I prefer keyboard and mouse, but the option's there). Attacks need to be aimed, making every shot a skill shot, and instead of staring at your ability bar to see when Ball Lightning is coming online you engage with the action. The readability problem other games in the genre struggle with is reduced, the size of the characters and cartoon aesthetic making it easier to tell what's going on and what you're supposed to take away from it.

Those characters are great too. They feel like castoffs from Saturday morning cartoons, like a crossover between BraveStarr, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, five shows about aliens that look suspiciously like Earth animals, and two about giant robots. Each has their own theme song that plays on the character select screen, with Froggy G's bouncy rap a highlight.

There's a French chameleon assassin who leaves decoys and turns invisible, a hairdresser in a VR helmet that makes her think she's using her scissors to cut hair and not throats, a Russian monkey cosmonaut who turned his rocket into a jetpack, and a squid sea captain named Admiral Swiggins. That's not even half of them.

And, blessed relief, there's no meta to speak of. Almost every one of the characters is a valuable part of a three-Awesomenaut team, and nobody throws a tantrum in the chat window because someone bought the wrong power-up. Only Clunk, a robot with a bite attack and self-destruct button, is seen as a bit of a liability in competitive play—everyone else is worthwhile.

That's not to say it's perfect. While Awesomenauts is the easiest MOBA to recommend to new players, those new players immediately face a two-part tutorial narrated by a robot with an incredibly annoying voice. It's skippable, but doing so means losing out on a hefty amount of Awesomecoins, the currency used to unlock characters who aren't part of each week's free rotation. And though Awesomenauts initially did without experience points, instead relying on Solar—basically gold—for in-game levelling up, they were later added by an expansion and have proved controversial. It's another reward for the team that's already winning, and another thing for new players to learn about.

But the matches are quick, usually around 15-17 minutes long, and the chat's relatively free of rage. Perhaps the quick matches and bright colors help keep it friendly—Overwatch is the only online game where I'm less likely to come out of a loss feeling frustrated by it. When you die you get launched back into the fight via drop pod, and spend most of your wait steering it to the ground collecting Solar on the way. It's a minigame that gives you something to do while waiting to rejoin play instead of stewing on your failure.

Another plus is that there are mods if you want some more maps or to sample the chaos of no-cooldown mode. Custom mode lets you try out these, as well as offline split-screen play, which is something I wish more MOBAs had, though perhaps it's uniquely suited to Awesomenauts' side-on view. 

Going free-to-play has given Awesomenauts a boost in player numbers, and I usually only have to wait a couple of minutes for a game at the moment. (During the wait there's a secret minigame you can find by pressing the tiny play button in the corner of your Awesomecoins balance, top right. You're welcome.) It's impossible to say how long this burst of interest will last, but Awesomenauts certainly deserves a second chance. In a crowded genre it's a rare standout, one with personality and the confidence to mess with the formula.

I'll leave you with Leon Chameleon's theme tune, a straight-up Serge Gainsbourg chanson. Leon is for lovers.

notes.title: Awesomenauts 4.0.6 - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6a68cd2167999fddccab5703a4526254c31fee54.png[/img]We just released a hotfix for Awesomenauts that addresses a couple of issues players have encountered over the last week. This includes fixes for the issue where players would be stuck in the queue at 0:00, the SlowWolf announcer not unlocking as intended, and other connectivity issues.

Catch the patch notes below for the full details on the issues that have been addressed. Please continue to let us know if you happen to run into  problems over on the official tech support forums: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=13

[h1]Update 4.0.6[/h1]
1-6-2017
 
[b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck in the matchmaker queue at time 0:00
[*]Fixed a bug that caused players get stuck in a party that didn’t allow them to play at all.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the matchmaker to go down altogether in very rare cases.
[*]Fixed that sometimes the Slowwolf announcer would not unlock.
[*]Fixed that for some people, not all prestige medals would be unlocked.
[*]Fixed that sometimes random announcer would result in no announcer at all.
[*]Invite suggestions will only show players who are in global chat.
[*]Fixed that the "Attack of the botanic Army!" achievement often didn't count the Weedlings you placed, and sometimes counted Weedlings you didn't place.
[*]Fixed that the game would reset last selected skins on startup.
[*]On first startup, the game language will now be determined by the language used in steam, instead of always defaulting to English for new users.
[*]To fix the massive recruitment code spam in global chat users can no longer post their recruitment code in global chat. Recruitment codes can still be shared via party or team chat or outside of the game.
[*]Global chat will block users from sending the same message within a short time period.
[*]Fixed the win streak statistic on the stats screen.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b][list][*]Fixed Penny bullets not bouncing off the ceiling[/list]

[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble: June Gathers[/h1]
The June Gathers tournament is now open for sign-ups. This casual tournament encourages players of every kind to join and get familiar with the competitive scene of Awesomenauts. More info on [url=https://sites.google.com/awesomenautsrumble.com/home/gathers]their website![/url]
 
[h1]ALP: Rookie Royale[/h1]
The Rookie Royale invites new players to join an Awesomenauts tournament. The team will be under supervision of a veteran, who will coach the players during the tournament. The sign-ups will start on the 3rd of June!
 
[h1]ALP: Awesomenauts Console Clash 3[/h1]
The tournament will start this weekend on the 3rd of June and continue on the 4th of June with the finals. There is still time to sign up and join the clash [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdnX_-8Wz4znyCjMdSjea1s1Btl5ExPQwQ-EvDNtDbI39mMug/viewform?c=0&w=1]here[/url]

[h1]Community highlight[/h1]
Wabtfan made a new custom map called Galactron Construct 127. Team iris doors shut when enemies are near; no droids nor Awesomenauts may pass through during this. The iris door remains open at all times after destruction of corresponding turret.

notes.title: Meet Rocket's Renegades - Dizzy now in Beta!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/cc9f8ba1c7e7b835eadfc4f3a158deff824a1858.jpg[/img]Meet: Rocket's Renegades! Commander Rocket, Qi'Tara, Smiles, and Dizzy have been on the run for years and are finally ready to face the ghosts that haunt their past... and they're doing that by joining the Awesomenauts!

Learn more about this crew in the trailer below: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d5p5DFP40Fw Dizzy is the first Renegade to enlist with the Awesomenauts, and she is now available in the open beta for Awesomenauts 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades! Her fellow Renegades will join the Awesomenauts in future updates, so stay tuned for more news on that!

To access the Beta for Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades, follow the steps below:[list][*]Right-click Awesomenauts in your Steam Library and select "Properties"
[*]Select the "DLC" tab and make sure "Awesomenauts - Beta dual-load" is checked.
[*]Wait until the beta is downloaded (this can take a while).
[*]Start the game
[*]Select "Play Awesomenauts Beta" and hit "PLAY"[/list]

On top of this brand new character, Update 4.1: Dawn of the Renegades also contains significant reworks for Derpl Zork and Yuri, as well as a huge array of balance changes. Catch the full patch notes below, but please note that these are subject to change ahead of the official release of Update 4.1

Please share your feedback on the Beta forum over on Awesomenauts.com: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=19

[h1][b]Update 4.1 Beta 1[/b][/h1]
31-5-2017
 
[b]NEW Naut: Dizzy[/b]
[i]Skills:[/i][list]
[*]Multi Dash: Save up to 3 dashes to unleash unto your enemies.
[*]Explosive Clone: Leave a water clone at your location that explodes and deals damage in an area.
[*]Bubble Shot: Fire a fast-moving bubble that deals damage.[/list]
 
[i]Short backstory:[/i][list]
[*]Using her mastery in Aqua-fu, Dizzy fooled the Scarg prison guards with her water clones and escaped along with her team. After being separated, she went back to her home planet to revitalize her singing career. There she formed a girl band called “the Dizzies” together with her water clones and conquered the Universal Music Charts in no time. A popularity poll showed that one of her clones was more popular than her, causing her to go on a graffiti spraying rampage. After being calmed by her old friends, she joins them into joining the Awesomenauts![/list]
 
[b]General[/b][list]
[*]You can now try out skins in the armory
[*]Added sound to the Solar shower in the testmap (the map where you can try out Nauts).
[*]Tweaked when announcers will count down. For instance, it won’t count down in the test level in the armory anymore.[/list]
 
[b]Map editor[/b][list]
[*]Added two new options to AffectAreas: [i]switchToClass[/i] and [i]switchToSkinIndex[/i]. These allow you to swap which character and skin the player uses. This can even be used to switch to characters that are normally not playable, like droids and creeps. Note that a player can only be switched to a class or skin he or she owns. When switching to a class you don’t own, nothing happens. When switching to a skin you don’t own while you do own the class, you instead switch to the default looks of that Naut.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ayla_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ayla[/b]
[i]Quality of life change and changing/buffing unpopular upgrades.[/i][list]
[*]Evil eye can now be shot when using rage. Rage will automatically turn off when using evil eye.
[*]Angry Drawings, reduced price from 250 to 220 solar per stage.
[*]Jail Food, increased damage over time from 105 to 135 per stage.
[*]Jail Food, reduced price from 215 to 200 solar per stage.
[*]Rubberband Ball, changed to a damage over time on the blood trail for 140 damage over 2 seconds.
[*]Rubberband Ball, increased price from 150 to 200 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Clunk_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Clunk[/b]
[i]Slight movement speed increase to make it harder to punish him.[/i][list]
[*]Base movement speed increased by 8%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Coco_Nebulon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Coco[/b]
[i]Damage increased of slightly too weak upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Superconductor, increased damage per homing particle from 13 to 15 damage per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Deadlift_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Deadlift[/b]
[i]Self knockback removed to allow him to stay in fights after lunging.[/i][list]
[*]Power Lunge, removed self knockback on the impact.
[*]Power Lunge, increased consistency by increasing the collision size by 10% while flying.
[*]Power Lunge, now only ends on collision instead of stopping mid-way when flying for a long time.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b]
[i]Made placing traps less risky and less frustrating to deal with.[/i][list]
[*]Grid trap, can now be thrown for a short distance. They deploy in place after flying for 0.75 seconds.
[*]Grid trap, lifetime reduced from 11 to 6 seconds.
[*]Strengthened Trap, lifetime increase reduced from 8 to 4 seconds.
[*]Empowered Grid, now speeds up Grid trap flight and deployment time by 50% for 180 Solar.
[*]Deployment Pads, knockback size reduced by 25%.
[*]Deployment Pads, made the knockback visual faster.
[*]Long Cat, now also increases the speed of Cat shot.
[*]Long Cat, reduced range and speed increase from 33% to 28% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Genji_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Genji[/b]
[i]Power reduced as he was quite strong. Problematic upgrade replaced.[/i][list]
[*]Butterfly Shot, base damage reduced from 70 to 65 damage.
[*]Monarch Blessing, base duration reduced from 3 to 2.5 seconds. 
[*]Spiritual Cooking, changed to a 1 second duration increase.
[*]Spiritual Cooking, price reduced from 195 to 155 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Gnaw_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Gnaw[/b]
[i]Reduced potency of a strong upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Overcharged Metabolism, amplified damage duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ix_the_Interloper_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ix[/b]
[i]Reduction of potential survivability.[/i][list]
[*]Crystal Crunch, reduced healing per target from 8 to 6 health per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Jimmy_and_the_LUX5000_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Jimmy and the LUX50[/b]
[i]Changes intended to make the character a bit more accessible and solid.[/i][list]
[*]Missile barrage can no longer be canceled 
[*]Movement during Missile Barrage is no longer blocked, but reduced by 40% instead.
[*]Charge, tick rate increased by 50%, knockback and damage reduced by 50%.
[*]Charge, movement speed reduced by 10%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sheriff_Lonestar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Lonestar[/b]
[i]Increased damage of some weaker upgrades.[/i][list]
[*]Missile, increased damage from 100 to 125.
[*]Another Missile, increased damage from 100 to 125.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Max_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Max Focus[/b]
[i]Droid damage reduction both for consistency and reducing pushing power.[/i][list]
[*]Brutalities of the Kraken unveiled!, the last projectile now deals 50% less damage VS droids like the rest of Scene Illumination.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Nibbs_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Nibbs[/b]
[i]A bunch of price reductions to help her early game.[/i][list]
[*]Eternal Flame, price reduced from 200 to 180 solar per stage.
[*]Autographed picture of Voran, price reduced from 180 to 160 solar per stage.
[*]Misery Tarot Cards, price reduced from 170 to 160 solar per stage.
[*]Blue&Orange Berries, price reduced from 185 to 165 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Penny_Fox_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Penny Fox[/b]
[i]Reduction of pushing power and auto-charge makes her a bit easier to play.[/i][list]
[*]Penny will now automatically generate one charge every 10s.
[*]Cookie Monster Badge, the increased damage now only applies against nauts.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Raelynn_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Raelynn[/b]
[i]Reduction of stalling potential.[/i][list]
[*]Timerift, increased cooldown from 9 to 11 seconds.
[*]Laserpointer, now only applies blind on hit.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Rocco_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Rocco[/b]
[i]Increase of pushing power.[/i][list]
[*]Rapid Arrows, added a small area of effect on hit (does not apply to SWCA Coin split arrows).[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Scoop_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Scoop[/b]
[i]Increase in potency of some weaker upgrades.[/i][list]
[*]Banner of the Triple Scoop, increase dps from 40 to 50 per stage.
[*]Spoonman, increased damage when allies are near from 6% to 8% per stage.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sentry_X-58_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Sentry[/b]
[i]Reducing hitbox size as it turned out to be too large and changing a frustrating upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Teleport Beacon, reduced teleportation pulse size by 20%.
[*]Glass Case of Emotion, changed to a 5 second cooldown reduction.
[*]Glass Case of Emotion, increased price from 115 to to 145 solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Sk%C3%B8lldir_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skølldir[/b]
[i]Making it a bit easier to land the 3rd punch.[/i][list]
[*]3rd punch will no longer collide with the ceiling.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Skree_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Skree[/b]
[i]Reducing strength in teamfights with this upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Ceremonial Mask, increased proc cooldown from 2s to 2.5s.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Ted_McPain_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Ted McPain[/b]
[i]Making stun-pack a bit trickier to apply to compensate for its strength.[/i][list]
[*]Grénaide pour homme, reduced stun area size by 25%.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Yuri_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Yuri[/b]
[i]A bunch of changes that make Yuri more active and less frustrating, both to play and to play against.[/i][list]
[*]Flight, acceleration increased by 33%.
[*]Flight, maximum speed reduced by 10%.
[*]Flight, maximum vertical speed increased by 20%.
[*]Laser, firing it now reduces movement speed by 60%, instead of locking Yuri in place.
[*]Laser, no longer bounces off walls.
[*]Laser, range reduced by 15%.
[*]Laser, time between damage stages increased from 0.5 to 1 seconds.
[*]Hubble’s lens, now increases movement speed while firing laser by 30%.
[*]Mine deploying, can now be thrown in an arc. Hold the button to throw further.
[*]Mine deploying, damage reduced from 410 to 300.
[*]Mine deploying, lifetime reduced from 10 to 4 seconds.
[*]Toaster timer, added mine lifetime reduced from 2 to 1.5 seconds per stage.
[*]Uranium Spikes, now reduces hit enemy damage by 10% per stage for 3 seconds, for 135 Solar.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Vinnie_&_Spike_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Vinnie & Spike[/b]
[i]Reducing potency of a strong upgrade.[/i][list]
[*]Antique Machinegun, reduced silence duration from 1.5 to 1.2 seconds.[/list]
 
[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Voltar_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Voltar[/b]
[i]Making knockback drone a bit trickier to apply to compensate for its strength.[/i][list]
[*]Cortex Tank, knockback size reduced by 25%.
[*]Cortex Tank, made the knockback visual faster.[/list]
 
[b]Known Issues:[/b][list]
[*]Buying One-time-only Exclusive Retro Edition Sneakers as Dizzy causes the Speedup effect to appear when dropping down with the drop pod (this does not increase the drop pod speed).[/list]

notes.title: Side-scrolling MOBA Awesomenauts is now free-to-play
notes.notes: Awesomenauts [official site], Ronimo’s 2D side-scrolling MOBA, has switched to free-to-play after almost five years. After commercial MOBAs exploded, most of the next wave were basically Lolbuts (‘like League of Legends but with…’) but Awesomenauts had an interesting take. It’s an action-platformer built upon the MOBA fundamentals of waves, bases, neutral enemies, and all that, an interesting rejiggling which casts off a lot of the MOBA baggage. If you fancy a crack, hey, it’s now free to play. Have a gander: … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: AWESOMENAUTS NOW FREE-TO-PLAY
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6a68cd2167999fddccab5703a4526254c31fee54.png[/img]
Great news everyone! Awesomenauts is now free to play on Steam!
 
This transition has been in the works for years and we’re incredibly excited about making the game available to many more players around the world!
 
A big thank you goes out to our community for helping us make this happen and for all the efforts you have taken to welcome new players! From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/204300/guides/]writing guides in the guide contest[/url] and setting up [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=47140]tournaments specifically aimed at newcomers[/url], to hosting [url=https://sites.google.com/awesomenautsrumble.com/home/home]shows about the competitive scene[/url] and [url=http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=50014&p=709962]organizing community events to highlight awesome custom maps[/url]… you guys are the best!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/e79f2f97c206d59599c310d81147836506710df6.png[/img] 
Over the next week, we’ll be hosting regular shows on Twitch.tv/RonimoGames where you can ask us questions, win prizes, and simply hang out. We’ve teamed up with community-favorite SlowWolf and will be bringing you regular shows to help new players get started. Feel free to join in on the fun! Here’s a schedule for when you can expect these shows to run (we’ll update the schedule throughout the week): http://steamcommunity.com/games/204300/announcements/detail/1271550628459751501 
Looking beyond the coming weeks, I can tell you we already have lots of new content lined up as well. We’ve recently been teasing a new character that will join the Awesomenauts in Update 4.1 and you can look forward to the full reveal on May 31st! Missed the last teaser image we did for the new 'Naut? You can find it below!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/734725d41d2cad212c6aed0412c312104e306063.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/734725d41d2cad212c6aed0412c312104e306063.png[/img][/url]
Join us on the Streamisho at 17:00 EU / 16:00 UK / 11AM ET / 8AM PT today as we celebrate the free-to-play launch of Awesomenauts and have a shot at winning cool skins!
 
For now, thanks again for all your support. You inspired us to make Awesomenauts into the game it is today, we are incredibly proud of what we’ve built together with our community over the years.
 
Rock on, and go play some ‘Nauts!
 
Much love,
 
Ronimo

notes.title: Addressing some issues for Chinese players
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/38a58b02fb15ec275e9333be07f709de549ceff1.png[/img]Hey everyone, over the last couple of months we've seen the Awesomenauts community grow significantly. Ever since we added a Simplified Chinese localization to Awesomenauts, many new players from the Chinese community have become avid Awesomenauts fans.

Unfortunately, with the growing number of players in the Chinese community it has become apparent that there are some issues affecting a significant number of players, making it impossible for them to connect to our matchmaking server. As a result, we've decided to temporarily restrict access for new players to the game by disabling the Play / Purchase button on the storefront. This change will go into effect shortly. This will not affect players that already own the game, but ensures new players (who are likely to have problems connecting to our server) can't get in until we've succesfully adressed the issue.

The move also shouldn't affect players located outside China, so if you're reading this it probably won't affect you.

The game will be made available again once we've adressed these issues, and when we do so the game will become free-to-play in China as well!

We're very sorry about this, as the Chinese community has quickly become one of our largest groups of players, but I hope you understand why we're doing this and will continue to support us. We want all players to have a great time playing Awesomenauts, and this is the best way for us to guarantee that happens!

We'll update the Chinese community regularly on our progress!

Thanks,

Ronimo

notes.title: Teasers, updates, and new tournaments!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/d3643ed15f32364fe616acb48439d3b80802d383.png[/img]
Yesterday marked the last Streamisho before Awesomenauts goes Free-to-Play! The launch of Awesomenauts 4.0 will be on May 24th and a lot of news was announced before the big release. We will cover the news below, but you can watch the VOD here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uwhZSp7-_G8
[h1]Update 4.0.3[/h1] 
In this update, which launched earlier this week, we improved the scoreboard based on community feedback and we will continue to iterate further to make it even more awesome!

Ammo bars were added for characters that use ammo-mechanics and the new visual help notifications for skills can be enabled/disabled in the settings. Check out the full patch notes here: http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=49979 

[h1]Reddit AMA[/h1]
We will be doing a Reddit AMA today (May 18th) at 17:00 EU (the same time as the start of the Streamisho). Here is the countdown timer, if you're not sure about when to tune in: http://buff.ly/2qrgaHC

The AMA can be found on: https://www.reddit.com/r/IAmA/
Have your burning questions ready!

[h1]New ‘Naut[/h1]
An old newspaper was flying around in space and the readers discovered that a group of space mercenaries escaped from prison on Carcaco back in 3584! The new ‘Naut joining the game in Update 4.1 might have something to do with their breakout![img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/6f387a6c6ff7bd82ff897bd34643a83cd5073ea6.png[/img]
[h1]Community news[/h1]

[h1]ALP[/h1]
The Awesomenauts League Project announced that there will be 3 events coming soon! Rookie Royale, Console Clash, and The Showcase were all announced during the stream. The sign-ups for the Console Clash and the Rookie Royale will start May 20th and May 24th respectively.

Check out this forum post for updated information on the announced tourrnaments:
http://www.awesomenauts.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=47140&start=20 

[h1]Awesomenauts Rumble[/h1]
The Awesomenauts Rumble: Gathers May edition will kick-off on the 20th of May with the Qualifiers and the Playoffs are live on May 21st! Both streams will start 12PM EDT on www.twitch.tv/awesomenautsrumble 

[h1]Workshop highlight[/h1]
In Squadnauts! by CationF, every player will spawn with the same ‘Nauts following them (Lonestars spawn Lonestars, Clunks spawn Clunks, etc).
They have a special custom AI and will follow you wherever you go, meaning you can have huge battles with lots of characters on screen!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=921941322

notes.title: Update 4.0.4 - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3948077/65518697327da94de7137c81c14b30ce65adb1c4.png[/img]
We just released update 4.0.4, an important update that helps us prepare our servers for the free-to-play launch on May 24th! This update contains some complex new features for our matchmaking system, though if everything works as intended you likely won't notice anything has changed.

We'll continue to monitor the performance of these systems over the coming days!

Full patch notes for this update are included below:

[h1][b]Update 4.0.4[/b][/h1]
18-5-2017

[LIST][*]Made changes so that our servers can handle much larger numbers of simultaneous players once we go free to play. This contains some rather complicated tech so we expect we’ll be doing further fixes to this in the coming days.
[*]Slightly increased the in-game scoreboard size.
[*]Items bought icons are now always shown in the scoreboard when your account level is 6 or higher.
[*]Fixed that you would sometimes still get invite suggestions when your party was already full.
[*]Fixed that poor connection popup would appear partially behind other menus.
[*]Fixed a rare crash while waiting for matchmaking.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Coco_Nebulon_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Coco[/b]
[LIST][*]-Fixed that Coco’s Ball Lightning visual was upside down when aiming to the left.[/list]

[img]https://www.awesomenauts.com/characters/image/Icon_Derpl_Zork_001.jpg[/img]
[b]Derpl[/b][LIST][*]-Fixed that Derpl’s Nuke visual was upside down when aiming to the left.[/list]
